notes.title: Patch 5.48
notes.notes: [p][b]Patch 5.48[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a GUI to manage guilds. This can be used to view and edit your roster, change the name, edit the colors, add a motto, and write a bulletin.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]\[improved] Sorting the bags was incredibly slow on some devices.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an auto-block feature. This change adds flags that allow restricting who can interact with a player, and can be found under [b]Settings < Options < Interaction Filters[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Guild Only: Only guild members can interact.[/p][/*][*][p]Friends Only: Only friends can interact.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]If the player is a member of a party, then permission is implicitly given to other party members to interact with the given player.[/p][/*][*][p]These can be set simultaneously, which would allow both friends and guild members to interact. notes.title: Patch 5.45 "Heads of Havoc" is now live!
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes 5.45[/h1]

[h2]General[/h2]
Activated Raids Season 10, 'The Heads of Havoc'

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed the requirements for some of the daily quests in the Northeast Crux.
[*] Satisfying Scarecrows
[*] Reduced the number of Crushed Poppy Petal Sacks from 8 to 4
[*] Reduced the number of Emerald Tortoise Blood Drops from 10 to 2.
[*] Reduced the number of Mulch Lizard Hearts from 10 to 2.
[*] Pondweed Pepper Spray
[*] Reduced the number of Deadly Pepper Sprays from 15 to 8.
[*] Satirical Supply Run
[*] Reduced the number of Dragonfly Blood Drops from 10 to 3.
[*] Reduced the number of Charcoal Acid Pellets from 10 to 1.
[*] Tidbits for a Toymaker
[*] Reduced the number of Smoky Flickers from 7 to 3.
[*] Reduced the number of Spicy Chlorophyll Globs from 7 to 2.
[*] Added "Common Socket Extra" for sale in the Midsummer Event vendor. 1 can be purchased for 5 Tears of Vesesia.
[*] Added gear recipe level boost to crafted gear recipes, allowing crafters to increase the level of certain recipes up to a specific maximum
[*] Heroic Raids were made easier at higher levels. Players should be able to reach the higher Heroic tiers more easily now.
[*] In Heroic Raids, more Epic gear will drop, and less Rare gear will drop.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Venom of the Serpent was appearing on Beasmaster bows instead of Ferocity of the Wolverine
[*] Trees near Elk's Shadow no longer have collision to prevent boss fight exploit
[*] Removed outdated text in Traven referencing keystones
[*] Hopeyfully fixed Chaminder's Demoms in Rift healing inproperly
[*] Fixed hole in terrain at "-480 -306 58" in the Southwest Crux.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused loot dropped by Zingara in the Crux not to be scaled to the appropriate level.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the Box of Grenades from vanishing during the quest, "Bunker Smuggling" in the Northeast Crux.
[*] Fixed issue that prevented trophy icon from appearing next to 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place players when there were multiple.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented bounties in the Oasis of Anuk'Amon to not drop Zorian Spores
[*] Fixed a wall in Myko's lair that didn't have a collider.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Cragmaw, Lethyra, Ebonscale, and Deepmaw in the NE Crux to spawn too quickly.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused auto-revive charges to be used while having lives remaining in raids. Raid lives will now be prioritized, and auto-revive charges will only be consumed when no raid lives are remaining.
[*] Maplecrest now tasks players to speak with Gladius
[*] Updated icon of Gladius' quests
[*] Updated minimum level requirement of Journey to the Frontier quest from 15 to 30
[/list]

[h2]Mobile Only[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the information for public and private villages to be swapped.
[*] Hopefully fixed an issue that caused Vault Logs from other villages to appear in the current village.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 5.42 is now live!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Patch Notes 5.42.0[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Relics at Heroic 50+ are now guaranteed to be rarity Epic or better.
[*] Removed the level 80 and 85 Elders from the main questline
[*] Note: If you currently have a quest objective to defeat the level 80 Elders, speak to Nadia in Dartrey Woods
[*] Note: If you currently have a quest objective to defeat the level 85 Elders, speak to Prince Zaan in Glendergan
[*] A character who goes by the name of Gladius has joined Arcra and Arcron in one of the rooms in Ardent Castle. He's a bounty hunter who has too many contracts to fill himself. He's looking for some help in tracking down some of the Venerable bosses. He offers rewards of xp, gold, and importantly, elder fragments. Note: we are hoping that his quest chain provides some of the gameplay that some players were missing when the elders were moved to Frontier Zones. The Venerables are not level-scaled, and not player-size-scaled, and provide a method for players to earn elder spells. In this way, higher level players can help lower level players when asked.

[*] Added vendor location to the description of Pyrrite medallions
[*] Increased stack size of "Fluffy Cotton Candy" from 500 to 9999.
[*] Removed Blasting from monster affix pool

[*] Added traveling vendor to Depths

notes.title: Patch 5.40 "SugarSweet & New Frontier Zones" Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes 5.40.5[/h1]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sugarsweet Summithas replaced Grinchta’s Lair
[*] New: Marrowfang Weapon Pack (Available in Item Shop and Event Zone)
[*] New Mounts: Raptors!
[*] Scarlet Raptor (Available in Item Shop and Event Zone)
[*] Evergreen Raptor (Item Shop)
[*] Cerulean Raptor (Item Shop)
[*] Lilac Raptor (Item Shop - Exclusives)
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Frontiers[/b]
[*] Blighted Bastille is now a Frontier Zone
[*] Shadow's Den is now a Frontier Zone
[*] Villar Summit is now a Frontier Zone
[*] The Shadowed Future is now a Frontier Zone
[*] Added new Bandit's Retreat Frontier zone
[*] Bounties within each Frontier zone will drop a specific currency which can be spent at faction vendor for cosmetics
[*] Updated world map with the new Frontier Zones
[*] All Frontier Zones now have zone maps
[*] Modified Forgotten Quarry map to reduce backtracking
[*] Rebalanced Frontier mobs
[*] Disabled mounts in Frontiers
[*] Added Watchful Eye debuff to Frontiers which reduces sneak power
[*] [b]Elder Changes[/b]
[*] Lady's Fate, Gutgor, Elk's Shadow, Droktor, Villarius, Valupsa and the level 80 Bandit Lords have been scaled and moved to Frontier zones
[*] The level 75 Elders have been scaled
[*] The level 85 Elders have been scaled
[*] Elders who remain as standalone bosses have been converted to solo'able Venerable bounties
[*] The Hero's Journey questline has been refactored to introduce players to their first Frontier
[*] Existing Elder Crests, Insignias, Ethers and Essences have been converted into a new leveless Elder Fragment
[*] Turnapin Cache now rewards Elder Fragments instead of level 85 Crest, Insignia, Ether and Essence
[*] Saphira’s Boon quest now rewards Elder Fragments instead of level 90 Crest, Insignia, Ether and Essence
[*] Level 95 Elder Chests now reward Elder Fragments instead of level 95 Crest, Insignia, Ether and Essence
[*] Scaled Elders will drop elder fragments which can be restored by Arcron in Ardent Castle into Fabled Armaments
[*] Elder Restoration Achievements will now reward players based on the number of Restorations completed
[*] [b]Fabled Gear[/b]
[*] Earthquake, Tidal Wave, Flaming Meteor, Bitter Chill, Mass Absorb Shield, Corrupting Plague, Ferocity of the Wolverine, Concussion Shot, Titanic Power and Dragon Strike have been moved to Fabled Weapons
[*] Note: These spells can still be gnogmented onto other weapons
[*] Note: Dropped fabled weapons will also have these spells attached
[*] Venom of the Serpent, Judgment, Unbreakable Will, Twister and Arcane Alacrity now drop from dropped weapons level 60 and above
[*] Reduced Fabled Gear drop rate from 10% to 5%
[*] [b]Rune Updates[/b]
[*] Dropped spell runes and passive runes will now have a rarity bump matching the rarity of the equipment item they came attached to

notes.title: Patch 5.39 is now live!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Patch Notes 5.39[/b][/h1]

Hi Everyone,

We wanted to take a moment to explain the recent changes to level 96-97 gameplay and assure you that this is not a nerf—it’s a recalibration to ensure long-term balance and fun for everyone. Here's what’s happening and why:



[h2][b]What Changed:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Previously, there was an unusually large jump in power at level 96 compared to earlier levels. This wasn’t consistent with the smooth progression from levels 1-95.
[*] We’ve adjusted the scaling for levels 96 and 97 to match the progression curve that has worked well for the game at all other levels.
[*] As part of this, both players and monsters at levels 96-97 will have less health and do less damage. But the balance remains the same—monsters are still more powerful than at level 95, and your character’s power remains in proportion to theirs.
[/list]


[h2][b]Why This Is a Good Thing:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Monsters at levels 96 and 97 were rebalanced too, meaning fights will feel fair and fun.
[*] We also gave crafted gear at levels 96-97 a slight boost, so it’s now even better than before.
[*] By fixing some bugs in the old system, we’ve ensured a smoother, more consistent gameplay experience moving forward.
[*] What It Means for You:
[*] Your character is not weaker compared to the game world. The numbers on your gear may look lower, but the effectiveness of your character is exactly as strong—or stronger—against the challenges you face.
[*] Raids and level 95 elder runs will now be slightly easier for level 97 players.
[/list]


[h2][b]Why We Made This Change:[/b][/h2]

We want to keep the game’s progression balanced and fair for everyone. The old jump at level 96 was fun in the short term but caused problems with balance that could have hurt the game in the long run. This is not just a subtle rebalancing-- it's fixing a design flaw. If we don't make this fix, then the system will remain broken and things will get more and more out of balance. This adjustment ensures everyone enjoys a smooth and rewarding experience, no matter where they are in the game, and provides the game with stability into the future.

We hope this clears up any confusion, but we’re always here to listen. If you have questions or concerns, feel free to share them—we’re committed to making Villagers & Heroes the best experience it can be.

Thank you for your understanding and support!



[h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] We’ve adjusted the scaling for levels 96 and 97 to match the progression curve that has worked well for the game at all other levels.
[*] Harmonic Nectar can now be traded.
[*] Gulch now costs 100 Chits to enter (was 222). Rewards have also been adjusted:
[*] Myko chest now gives 16 Chits (was 29)
[*] Kaal chest now gives 32 Chits (was 78)
[*] Aene chest now gives 48 Chits (was 111). Additionally 1% bonus Chit amount is now 300 (was 666).
[*] Baun chest now gives 96 Chits (was 144). Additionally 1% bonus Chit amount is now 600 (was 888).
[*] Added blockers to the cliffsides in certain Gulch Elder warp points, so that players can't fall off and die.
[*] We changed the Ginny Gnogmentation Quest so that:
[*] It can be repeated with each Rebirth.
[*] It provides a reward of 2 free sockets.
[*] We gave level 96 crafted gear a power rating increase of +10.  We gave level 97 crafted gear a power rating increase of +15.  This is in addition to their natural boosts that come from being the highest level gear available.
[*] 
[/list]
[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [Fixed] Enhancement sometimes makes the item worse.
[*] Fixed an issue that cause Socorro Guild Discount to not apply.
[*] The effect, "Gulch Stamp" now only lasts for 30 minutes (was 2 hours).
[*] Hopefully fixed an issue that caused players to sometimes get locked out of raids, and required a server reset to fix them.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused raid lives to be consumed while the raid wasn't ongoing.
[*] After death bosses in the Gulch will now create a portal that teleports players that stand within it to the next section. This portal lasts for 30 seconds.
[*] Reduced the bounty respawn timer on some Southwestern Crux bosses, so that if players defeat an early one faster than previously, they can still get all the rewards from the rest.
[*] 
[/list]

[h2][b]PC Only
[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that would sometimes cause a normal revive to be used after using a Voltan's Resurrect if the "Resurrect" button was tapped extremely quickly.
[*] Hopefully fixed an issue that caused stages, and raid lives to not update on the client when joining a raid right as it starts.
[/list]

notes.title: Compensation for Crux crafting change has been distributed
notes.notes:
On Dec 16th, we greatly reduced the amount of xp required for a crafter to progress from level 96 to level 97, in each of the four crafting lines: Smithing, Woodcrafting, Tailoring, and Cooking. We believe this was a good change that was for the good of the game since the amount of work was just too much. It's part of a larger pass we are making on the Crux to improve it by fixing bugs and making some things easier and/or more player friencly (some of these changes have already been done, and there are still a few more things we're working on within the Crux -- but we won't go into those now-- this post is about crafting compensation package).

However, reducing the amount of crafting xp required to reach level 97 was unfair to those players who had already made progress toward 97. They had to work much harder than the players who came after them. This compensation package is being provided to those hard working players in recognition of their effort, and to keep the game fair.

The size of the compensation package is based on how much progress each character made from crafting level 96 toward 97, within each of the four crafting skills. The items being compensated are specific to the relevant crafting skill. For example, Smithers will receive many Koldcore Ingots, Woodcrafters will receive many Teak Timbers, etc.

Crafters who reached level 97 will receive the full compensation package. Those who got part of the way will get partial compensation. For example, a character who progressed 50% of the way from 96 to 97 will get 50% of the full compensation package. This is so that the amount of the compensation corresponds to the amount of effort.

The crafting skill level that was used to determine these amounts is the character's crafting skill level when the build on Dec 16 was pushed. Therefore, players will not be compensated for crafting skill level progress that occurred AFTER the crafting xp was reduced--it's only for the work that these players put in when the requirements were much harder.

In addition to the per crafting skill compensation, we will also be providing some compensation on a per character basis of various experience boosting potions.

Players who had multiple characters with progress toward crafting level 97 will receive compensation for each and every one of their characters with progress toward 97.

(Also, the way our system is set up, we cannot dispense gold via these commands -- so we have include gems as part of the compensation package, which can be sold for gold.)

We will be distributing the packages, server by server. Since we've not done rewards this way before, we want to make sure everything goes smoothly before we do all the servers.

notes.title: 12 Days of Christmas Contest #2: Server Donation!
notes.notes:
And here we go!  It’s that time of year again!  BUT GUESS WHAT?  We’ve decided to change things up this time around!  Instead of growing items in your garden and emailing them to an event character who sells them for gold, instead we want you to email the character gathered materials of any kind, who will then sell them for charter tokens.  That’s right, this is a charter token donation contest!



On every server, there is a special event character named [b]CharterChap[/b].  For the next two weeks, mail CharterChap gathered materials of any kind at all! [b]CharterChap[/b] will sell all the mats for charter tokens.  All of the earned charter tokens will be converted into Crystals of the Benevolent Villager, which will be available to any player who wants to host a crafting party on their server.  Additionally, as part of the 12 days of X-mas Event, this contest also provides servers with the opportunity to earn two special gifts for each player on their server.



As in previous years, because of the differing population sizes of the servers, we are combining several servers together.  But this year, LatAm will be partnered with US3!

[list]
[*] LatAm and US3 will be combined
[*] EU1 and EU2 will be combined
[/list]


This means we will combine the charter tokens earned from those servers, and distribute the crystals and gifts to each of those servers as one amount.  (We won’t split the combined amount in half.)



[h1]The Rules[/h1]

Mail gathered materials of any kind to [b]CharterChap[/b].  If you are unsure if the items can be sold for charter tokens, just check with the NPC named Zoran in Ardent City. ONLY items which can be sold for charter tokens will be accepted.  Any other sent items which cannot be sold for tokens will not be accepted.
Alts are absolutely permissible!  There is no limit to the number of times players may donate. The more the better!
It is not necessary to post on this forum thread after making donations. We will be posting on-going tallies every other day of the amount of charter tokens that each server has earned.
This contest will close on:  December 21st.
200,000 charter tokens = 1 Crystal of the Benevolent Villager
5 million charter tokens = one special gift sent to every player
10 million charter tokens = a second special gift sent to every player
This contest does not have individual winners, it is server-only based.


Happy Donating!  We love seeing you all rally together for the common good, and in previous years, we’ve been amazed with the generous spirit and effort this contest inspires on all of the servers. (Not to mention a little competitive fun.)  So good luck, and have fun!   😃



And once again, the name of the character to mail your gathered materials to is:


[h1][b]CharterChap[/b][/h1]

As a thank you to our subscribers, Part One of our long awaited expansion, The Crux, is now available to them! Ardent Society members can enjoy special access into the mysterious realm of Queen Zoria whose tyranny and madness is cruelly felt by the unique race of insect creatures who dwell in this wondrous land, and need the help of intrepid heroes. All new story quests, adventures, sights, and more await in this exciting patch which also comes with a level cap raise, new gear recipes, mounts, and a slew of other game improvements. The Seven Realms just got a little bigger! *Please speak with the NPC in the Zorian Marshlands named Rikey if you have completed the quest, Marshland Reclamation, and are an Ardent Society member to access The Crux.

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]  Added new high level content: The Crux Part One

[*]  Raised Level Cap to 97

For example, if the Priest had 10 curses on the target, instead of boosting the player's health and mana by 3% ten times in a row, it will instead boost the player's health and mana by 30% once.

notes.title: Villagers & Heroes: Wrath Of The Black Thrush expansion is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/T1BhlPx.gif[/img]

Villagers & Heroes is thrilled to announce the upcoming launch of a truly exhilarating new expansion! Wondrous new zones full of mystery and beauty, rousing story-driven quests which twist and turn and are not for the faint of heart, an abundance of sleek new mobile features and improvements, and the introduction of a whole new gameplay mechanic are but a few of the exciting new elements which await in, Wrath of the Black Thrush!


[h1][b]BRAVE THE DUNGEONS![/b][/h1]

With the release of the latest chapter in the Black Thrush storyline, we are thrilled to announce the introduction of an all new gameplay mechanic to Villagers & Heroes: repeatable group content in the form of dungeons!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CFL91aP.jpg[/img]

That’s right! Gather your friends and neighbors, and gather them well, for these grueling dungeons, which offer lavish daily rewards, cannot be soloed, but instead will require true teamwork. Group content means just that - well thought out teams comprised of the different classes and bolstered by the attributes of each are necessary for success!

Patterned after specific zones in the new Black Thrush content and named ‘Heroic’ to differentiate them from those normal zones, the portals to the first three dungeons will be accessible upon completion of each version of the ‘regular’ zone. Once a player has completed the quests and defeated the bounties in the ‘regular’ version of the zone, the Heroic Dungeon portal version of that zone will then become accessible forever after to players, even after rebirths. 

And just what do these exciting Heroic Dungeons have to offer players? So much!
[list]
[*][b]Fabulous rewards![/b] Powerful armaments and large amounts of gold and experience are awarded upon completion of Dungeon quests.
[*][b]Unlimited gameplay![/b] Dungeons can be repeated any number of times per day, giving equally good rewards each time.
[*][b]A ticking clock![/b] Dungeons have a timed component: the faster a group completes the dungeon, the better the rewards. A group can earn Gold Tier, Silver Tier, Bronze Tier, or No Tier. (But even a ‘No Tier’ will still offer great rewards!)
[*][b]Diversity of accolades![/b] Each of the three dungeons upon launch will reward from a different pool of armament slots, enabling players to carefully choose which dungeons they’d prefer to do.
[*][b]Bonus rewards![/b] The first time completing a dungeon during a week will grant players special bonus rewards.
[*][b]Repeatable quests![/b] Each dungeon will offer a main repeatable quest, which require such objectives as killing powerful enemies and bosses. Upon completion, an NPC will appear at the end of the zone for players to turn their quest in to.
[/list]


[h1][b]TAKE ON THE BLACK THRUSH![/b][/h1]

The latest intriguing chapter of the Black Thrush has arrived! Clever heroes, those ready to unravel a lengthy series of dangerous and stimulating quests, are needed in order to help save the realm from the increasingly insidious threat of the Black Thrush. Operating in stealth and murderous silence as always, their masked numbers have drastically increased and a treacherous new plot is underway.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yYqyNlg.jpg[/img]

Learn more secrets of the past, while solving mysteries of the present and see how the two will ultimately collide in this roller-coaster of a ride which will take players through eerily beautiful new zones rife with danger, and where the deadliest of creatures now reside. Be prepared for a thoroughly engrossing adventure like no other! Who among you will be able to survive the terrible wrath of the Black Thrush… 
[list]
[*]Picks up with Lady Philippa where the quest "Renovations" previously ended.
[*]Spans levels 25 through 35.
[*]Progresses through 9 different zones, most of which have been entirely overhauled.
[*]A whole host of new characters with all new voiced dialog.
[*]Exciting new quest mechanics and rewards.
[*]Loads of new bounty bosses.
[*]And much much more!
[/list]

[h1][b]ENTER THE MARSHLANDS![/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aoLZWHT.jpg[/img]

That ever lurking but always just out of grasp zone, the Zorian Marshlands, has at last slithered onto the world map! This murky swamp of slimy critters and foul beasties, not to mention deeply corrosive magics, is available only to those persevering heroes who have heretofore conquered all other preceding zones in the game. High level players, we invite you all to risk the perils and wonders of this deliciously evil new zone where a multitude of quests, battles, and sinister mysteries await. 

The journey with that ragtag bunch of wayward adventurers known as the Lumineers continues! The search for the missing priest, Lysander, the seventh Lumineer who disappeared so long ago, has intensified. New clues to his whereabouts have been discovered. A riddle is in need of solving. The clock is ticking. Just what mysteries do these sinister Marshlands hold about Queen Zoria, ruler of that strange and infamous land known as the Crux? Find out these answers, and much more!

We are thrilled to announce that our latest expansion, Wellspring, one filled with massive improvements to crafting and gathering, village life, and so much more, is now live! 

With Wellspring, we’ve transformed the weighty and elaborate crafting and gathering elements of the game into a lean, tight system, one which, though now much simplified, still contains the richness and complexity as it ever did before! And get ready for some amazing new Village Projects!

What kinds of things can you expect with this expansion?

Wellspring brings fully customizable environments for villages! Players can choose from a massive array of skies, trees, flowers, terrain, and regions, to truly create the ultimate village for themselves!

Village Politics has received an exciting overhaul! Players can now ‘Govern on the Go!

Wellspring introduces Auto-Gathering and Crafting! No more sore fingers from endless clicking on nodes, or at the various crafting stations!

Countless improvements have been made to gardening, ranching, crafting recipes, and more, all of which seamlessly promote a new fluidity and ease to the villaging aspect of Villagers & Heroes!

Brand new daily login rewards, grouped into monthly calendars with especially lucrative prizes have been added!

Wellspring has much to offer all players. The volume of changes and improvements in this exciting expansion, can hardly be listed out in its entirety here, so we encourage you all to please read the [url=www.madottergames.com/patchnotes/#r=en&p=4.14.0]full patch notes[/url], and visit our special [url=www.villagersandheroes.com/wellspring]Wellspring website[/url].

notes.title: Villagers and Heroes 4.0
notes.notes:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/oBj8uSw.jpg]

Villagers and Heroes has been updated with its biggest expansion ever, taking the game to the next level.

[h1][b]More action. More Loot. More Fun.[/b][/h1]
An entirely new loot system that drives action and fun. An completely overhauled talent system that lets players unlock rule-shattering ultimates. New and improved user interface, snappier more interesting combat, new content, and more.

[h1][b]Removal of many F2P Mechanics[/b][/h1]
With new mechanic changes, the game has never been more accessible to play. Mounts are now available to all players for FREE. The paid fast travel system has been removed. No more penalties after death. Experience to level has been vastly reduced. Gathering grind has been reduced by 75%. And the list goes on! It has never been a better time to play!

[h1][b]But don’t take our word for it...[/b][/h1]
[i]“I looooooove the new gear system (as a fan of arpg's like Diablo where loot is always random); it's an actual hunt for perfect gear…” -Rin Mitsuri[/i]

[i]“Our characters are SO much more customizable now. Crafting has gotten really fun, and killing things gives you more cash and interesting, unique gear… So fun. So many new possibilities!!!!” -Scraggle18[/i]

[i]“…Loving this game. Such a perfect mix of WoW and RS...without any hassle” -Eiyer[/i]

Welcome to Villagers and Heroes 4.0!

More information can be found here: http://www.thestararrives.com/

Specific Patch notes can be found here: http://thestararrives.com/patchnotes/

notes.title: Starfall Arrives in One Day!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0PMvXp5.png[/img]


Villagers & Heroes is thrilled to bring you our exciting, massive, new update,[b] STARFALL[/b] , on Wednesday, September 20th!


What can you expect?  A completely revamped loot system!  All new talent trees and feats!  New high level content and quests, with four brand new zones!  New character appearances!  A level cap raise to 90!  Terrifying new Elder Bosses!  And, much, much, more!

[h1]Visit our special Starfall Website to learn all about the extensive improvements, advanced features, and exciting new changes made to V&H: http://www.thestararrives.com/[/h1]


Items and Gear have received an electrifying overhaul.  Whether you prefer battling deadly foes in the wild, or crafting your own unique gear, our revamped loot system now provides players with amazingly new powerful gear!


Crafting has been made more complex and robust than ever before, with more stat boosts to items, the addition of runes (feats on items which can be moved between the items), and a whole new tiered system of rarities!

The four character classes have been entirely refurbished, and are more dynamic than ever!   Each class now has 12 talents grouped into 3 specializations per class.  Unlock powerful Ultimates for your character, as you fully level up your talents -- these game changing effects and brand new combat feats will revolutionize your style of play, and provide players with an endless array of compelling choices for their characters.


Quest lovers can look forward to a whole new adventurous storyline:  ‘The Journey to the Crux!’  With Starfall comes the first four new high level zones in a series of seven!  Players will be tasked with unraveling mysteries, traversing beautiful, but deadly new regions, all in an effort to reach that perilous land known as The Crux, where a dark new madness has lately descended.  Heroes are needed!

In addition to all of the above new changes, Starfall also brings with it a whole slew of other improvements:  A new world map, redesigned tooltips, vast new UI improvements, new hairstyle customization options, new outfits and mounts, and many bug fixes.

Furthermore, on launch day, all players will receive a FREE mount, free sockets, a free outfit, and a free makeover kit!

Players, get ready for a truly extraordinary new build, and one of the most exciting chapters in V&H history.  

[h1]You can read the full Starfall patch notes here:  http://thestararrives.com/patchnotes/[/h1]

notes.title: Patch 3.26.4
notes.notes:
[IMG]https://giant.gfycat.com/RichCluelessCoelacanth.gif[/IMG]

[h1]Patch 3.26.4[/h1]

Sugarsweet Summit has arrived!  Everyone's favorite, happy, event zone is back, and we've got some great new outfits and mounts for you this year!  Additionally, this build features a good many new improvements, and lots of bug fixes, and the addition of French!  :)


[b] Improvements[/b] 
[LIST]
[*]Made some efficiency changes to Ardent City, players should see improved FPS while in the zone.
[*]French has been added to V&H!  (As well as the rest of Portuguese.)  To play the game in French, go to Settings < Options < Language.
[*]Adjusted which markers are shown on top in the map, to make it easier to see party members, bounties, and quests.
[*]Bounty markers now turn gray when you have completed them for the day or they are inactive.  (Previously they would turn gray when they were not spawned.)
[*]Emote popups now appear over the heads of any character that does an emote.
[*]Updated quest icons on the map and above NPCs:
[LIST]
[*]Available main quests are shown with a purple "!"
[*]Destinations within a main quest are shown with a purple "?"
[*]The completing objective in a main quest is shown with a purple star
[*]Available side quests are shown with a yellow "!"
[*]Destinations within a side quest are shown with a yellow "?"
[*]The completing objective in a side quest is shown with a yellow star
[/LIST]
[*][b]Sugarsweet Summit has arrived![/b]  New outfits!  New mounts!  And a few more fun tidbits!
[/LIST]


[b] Bug Fixes[/b] 
[LIST]
[*]Added a far bank to the eastern side of the southern portion of the fishing river in the village.
[*]Fixed a hole in Bevyn's Coille.
[*]Added some fishing nodes to Goblin Roots Caves.
[*]Clarified Lil' Pip's text to explain that you must be at least level 75 to use his experience boosting services.
[*]The quest 'Cora Control' now correctly tracks.
[*]Fixed a few zombies that would get stuck on trees in Zombie town.
[*]Fixed a stuck location near Coalshark.
[*]Fixed a stuck locale in Dundeen Quarry.
[*]Fixed some typos in the Black Thrush storyline.
[*]Fixed a potential exploit.
[*]Fixed: bounty icons in minimap flicker.
[*]Fixed: in friends window, offline friends incorrectly say they're "Level 1 Warrior", and online friends often show out-of-date zone.
[*]Fixed Articulation Restoration track points were not that accurate.
[*]Fixed a stray drake in Sailors End.
[*]Fixed a hole in Knockroe wall.
[*]Fixed it so if you lose Archaic Symbol Note, your quest progress won't be blocked.
[*]Fixed: chat bubble text wasn't being centered correctly.
[*]Fixed: in very rare cases, a rebirth could fail.
[*]Fixed: in certain rare cases, the Make New Auction window wouldn't close after pressing Make (although the auction would start anyway).
[*]Fixed: on PC, normal friends were sometimes shown in the guild member list too.
[*]Fixed: shift-clicking on items to move them into the vault would not always stack.
[*]When you receive a new quest, "Track Quest" button is now to the left, instead of right, of "OK" button.
[*]Fixed: Gontier had his legs in the ground.
[*]Fixed a stuck spot in Shadow's Den.
[*]Fixed: NPCs would sometimes be stuck standing in a T-pose.
[*]Fixed a very rare case where players could get the NPC Aislinn in a weird state during her quest in Bearhold Crypt.
[*]Unearthed some berry bushes in Siren's Course.
[*]Clarified the goal text for 'The Brindle Rebellion' to note that a player must do a few tasks before Perdita will accept the badge.
[*]Added some clarifying text to the achievement "Pelog Grinder"
[*]Fixed: Salvaging Rods, Repair Kits, and certain other items would be "dropped" from the cursor when used on an item, instead of staying so they could be used again.
[*]Fixed several issues for players with unicode characters in their names.
[*]Fixed: After completing the quest with Winifred, her exclamation would stay up.
[*]Fixed a bounty that would spawn on a tent in Pyrron Courtyard.
[*]Fixed: dropping mail items into a stack would move the items, but would leave a fake stack behind in mail until you closed and reopened the mail.
[/LIST]

notes.title: Patch 3.24.6
notes.notes:
[h1] Patch 3.24.6[/h1] 

[IMG]http://giant.gfycat.com/IdolizedAccomplishedKentrosaurus.gif[/IMG]

Hi, Everyone! Grinchta and gang have departed, but we've got a meaty little build to keep you all busy in the mean time. :)

New lower level content! ('King Leo and The Rise of the Black Thrush.')  Lots of mobile improvements!  Bug fixes galore!  New maps and icons!  A slew of 'under the hood' alterations to improve lag and delays! And much, much, more!


[b]Improvements[/b] 
[LIST]
[*]Inventory and item control now is much more responsive and robust.  
[*]Zone maps for levels 1-25 have been much altered and improved.
[*]Most zone map icons have been redesigned to be clearer.
[*]Updated zone map grid and letters on PC to be more visible.
[*]Fishing spots in all zones are MUCH more visible, and the fish can actually be seen swimming in them!
[*]Citizens of Lake Kiwa have been busy. Lake Kiwa now includes all gathering nodes from level 1 to level 25.
[*]Added water wells in the Marigold crafting area.
[*]New voiced lines have been added to the story content for levels 11-25!
[*][B]New Lower Level Content![/B] The story of The Black Thrush continues, right where it left off in Ardent Castle, and will take players from level 15 up to level 25. It's a long and involved quest line, which, in addition to having some exciting new gameplay surprises within it, also features a great many zones that have been made wondrously new again!  The following zones have all had cosmetic surgery and/or alterations made to them (and maybe even a few new bounties!):
[LIST]
[*]Trader's Path
[*]Southern Coast
[*]Southern Marsh
[*]Lake Kiwa
[*]Sea Caves
[*]Siren's Course
[*]Sailor's End
[*]Zombie Town
[*]The Sewer's of Ardent
[*]Green Gate
[*]Forever's Advent
[*]Forever Tree
[/LIST]
[/LIST]


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[LIST]
[*]Internal changes to improve the stability of effects, preventing them from disappearing even during server failure.
[*]Fixed: sometimes a quest tracker slot could get stuck.
[*]Fixed an issue where clicking on feats rapidly and repeatedly would cause massive (5 - 10+ seconds) latency and throttling.
[*]Improved reliability of pingPyC counter.
[*]Crowns sales and item sales are now shown directly in the front page of the Shop, and the number of bonus crowns are shown in the Buy Crowns page.
[*]Changed the name of Rat King to just Rat.
[*]Replaced some confusing bounties.
[*]Fixed it so Arcron casts his magic in the right spot again.
[*]Fixed a bad mining rock in Gandymeade Grove.
[*]Fixed Garrin's cave to be more homey.
[*]Fixed some trees in Lady's lake that could capture players in their leaves.
[*]Fixed some bad mushroom nodes.
[*]Make Cornelius say something after Samuel vanishes to help guide players.
[*]Fixed an issue where players with increased combat speed would have their Benevolent potion visual effect (not actual gameplay effect) run out before the duration expired.
[*]Removed Bounty Master zone achievements.
[*]Fixed a gathering issue. If there is an extreme difference in level between the players skill level and the node, the chance to find the item is now 0% instead of 1%. If you 'did not find anything' during a gather, you are unable to find Motes of Yorick, Repair Globules, Lucky Gems, and Supplies.
[*]Made fishing holes in Maiden easier to see.
[*]Fixed a stuck spot in Kingsport.
[*]Dropped Balfoure's toupee quantity needed from 4 to 2. Boosted the drop rate from 75% chance to 100% chance.
[*]Dropped the mud dobber and cream popper quantity needed from 3 to 1 each. Each item only has a single node that now directly guides / tracks the player to the spot.
[*]Added more clarifying text to Gandymeade gossip quest goals to help the players find the gossip easily.
[*]Decreased the shadows in Pyrron dungeons .
[*]Fixed a stuck location in Bellacove Tide-pools.
[*]Fixed it so certain mobs that should be quiet won't be screaming out in a human voice.
[*]Fixed it so Maradar spores can be seen.
[*]Added fishing nodes to the areas in the tutorial where NPCs are fishing so new players don't get confused.
[*]Went through all tutorial quest text and added clarifying locations about which zones the goal takes place in.
[*]Fixed a rare case where players could get stuck not being able to turn in the quest "Finding Lorcan" to Rosemunda.
[*]Fixed a stuck location near Lady's Fate.
[*]Fixed it so master Gathering quest in tutorial no longer mentions "upper ethos".
[*]Made Eamon look a bit less cartoony.
[*]Updated a few very small things in Summer's Hollow to make the experience better for new players.
[*]Removed the word 'reins' from mount items.
[*]Added some clarifying text in the Pyrrus leaflet delivery quest. Some players believe they are bugged, but most likely it is because they do not have the leaflets in their inventory. The goal will now instruct them to return to Bianca if they have lost the leaflets.
[*]Fixed an issue that would not allow ear mites to drop anymore if you lost yours for Rafferty's quest. Also updated some completed text for larynx worms to clarify that you need seven of them.
[*]Fixed a case where a player could get stuck after giving Nadia Tufts of Boar fur.
[*]The auctioneers ledger is no longer available for Red Doubloons. It was buggy and caused issues.
[*]Tweaked balance numbers on Red Darrig world drop rates. Chest chances have gone down, key rates have gone up.
[*]Fixed a case where players couldn't find Dionte in Lampkin Village after completing Defusing the Feud. If this has happened to you, you'll need to go back to Dionte near the Mire of Shame and talk through his dialog fully.

notes.notes:
[h1] Patch 3.24.6[/h1] 

[IMG]http://giant.gfycat.com/IdolizedAccomplishedKentrosaurus.gif[/IMG]

Hi, Everyone! Grinchta and gang have departed, but we've got a meaty little build to keep you all busy in the mean time. :)

New lower level content! ('King Leo and The Rise of the Black Thrush.')  Lots of mobile improvements!  Bug fixes galore!  New maps and icons!  A slew of 'under the hood' alterations to improve lag and delays! And much, much, more!


[b]Improvements[/b]

[*]Inventory and item control now is much more responsive and robust.  
[*]Zone maps for levels 1-25 have been much altered and improved.
[*]Most zone map icons have been redesigned to be clearer.
[*]Updated zone map grid and letters on PC to be more visible.
[*]Fishing spots in all zones are MUCH more visible, and the fish can actually be seen swimming in them!
[*]Citizens of Lake Kiwa have been busy. Lake Kiwa now includes all gathering nodes from level 1 to level 25.
[*]Added water wells in the Marigold crafting area.
[*]New voiced lines have been added to the story content for levels 11-25!
[*][B]New Lower Level Content![/B] The story of The Black Thrush continues, right where it left off in Ardent Castle, and will take players from level 15 up to level 25. [*]Southern Coast
[*]Southern Marsh
[*]Lake Kiwa
[*]Sea Caves
[*]Siren's Course
[*]Sailor's End
[*]Zombie Town
[*]The Sewer's of Ardent
[*]Green Gate
[*]Forever's Advent
[*]Forever Tree

notes.title: Patch Notes 3.23.1
notes.notes:
[img]https://giant.gfycat.com/HeavenlySilkyItalianbrownbear.gif[/img]

Tis the season!  Grinchta and his evil elvish cohorts are back!  Get ready for a whole lot of snowy battles, festive gifts, new outfits and toys, the Advent Calendar, and a few other little surprises!


[b]Improvements[/b]
[LIST]
[*]It is Christmas again in Ardent City. Features: Christmas version of Ardent City, Grinchta's Lair is back, new outfits, pets, and mounts both in the store and in the event. New achievements.
[*]Clarified the error messages when something goes wrong during sign in.
[*]Bug reports will now show an overlay while sending, instead of running in the background, to avoid losing reports from players who close the game right after.
[*]Updated zone maps for Gilly Tunnel and Summer's Hollow
[*]New characters will now start with items rather than a starting supply bag. Tools will automatically be equipped, combat potions will be placed in quick slots, and all else will be placed in the inventory.
[*]Numbers 1000 and higher now use a comma divider instead of locale-specific divider, to fix display issues on some machines
[/LIST]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed it so players can't equip gathering and crafting tools that are higher than their corresponding skill.
[*]Fixed an issue where Lothar could talk forever if you didn't have the book he needs.
[*]Added some clarifying dialog to Aislinn for players who think they are stuck on Sorcery Suction Serum (most likely the player just doesn't have the required 30s).
[*]Fixed an issue where sometimes when you would turn in an ink bottle it would mention pipe of a headmaster.
[*]Fixed an issue where the quest Dream On could get in a weird state if a player ended up with Burga's Whistle early (bugged players should just go talk to Caravaggio again and have him teleport you).
[*]Fixed a possible exploit.
[*]Fixed an issue where on rare occasions a player could get stuck not being able to turn in the quest 'A Theater Affair'
[*]Changed it so Elta, Otto, and Ginny are always in Summer's Hollow, however they won't give players their quests until after they have completed the theater portion of Summer's Hollow.
[*]Removed mention of companions per slot in pet tooltips.
[*]Update the 'friend in zone' icon
[*]Changed it so that if a new player starts killing goblins in Gilly tunnel before they have talked to Winifred, it will automatically activate the quest and move them forward in the story line.
[/LIST]

notes.title: V&H Mobile and Steam / Cross-Platform
notes.notes:
As we have received a few questions on this topic, here's a summary to clear things up -

There is no way to log into the mobile version with a Steam account, due to our license agreement with Valve. This is purely for legal reasons, so there's nothing we can do on our end here.

We are sorry for this inconvenience - hopefully, you will be able to continue enjoying V&H regardless of the platform you choose to play on. :)

notes.title: Patch Notes 3.20.13
notes.notes:
This is a follow-up, fix-it build to the last patch.  We've also made some significant changes to the drop rates in the Equinox event zone.

[b] Improvements[/b] 
[LIST]
[*]Equinox Changes
[LIST]
[*]The chance of finding wings from a Pharaoh's chest: 1% -> 6%
[*]The chance of finding wings from a Caliph's chest: 0.4% -> 7%
[*]The chance of finding a Djinn Fairy Lamp in a Sand Darrig's chest: 0.5% -> 1.5%
[*]The chance of finding relic shards in a Darrig chest has remained the same, but when you do find them, you find more.
[*][B][U]Important note[/U]: We have heard and read lots of feedback about Equinox. Players do not like pure random luck! Let it be heard, let it be done! Spooky Town (and future event zones) will not rely on these luck mechanics (there may still be little luck mechanics here and there, but it won't be in this quantity or severity)[/B].
[/LIST]
[*]Warrior Feat Icons: Phoenix Strike and Whirlwind were updated to better convey their meanings
[/LIST]


[b] Bug Fixes[/b] 
[LIST]
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing bountiful watering pitchers to be sold for 1c. After this patch goes live,  bountiful watering pitchers that were obtained via this bug will be deleted from player inventories.
[*]Fixed: when using a ranged feat to target and attack an enemy, character would run towards the enemy.  Character now only runs to get into range required by the feat, no closer.
[LIST]
[*]Note that fixing this required reverting another fix, where using a feat with no spirit left would turn off auto-attack.
[/LIST]
[*]Fixed: doors would snap closed the moment they were opened.
[*]Fixed: jumping with Gnomish Jumping Boots stopped playing a flip animation due to a bug.
[*]Fixed: issues with chat tabs and party pane becoming messed up.
[*]Some players reported an error with the boss Zagreb. Turns out all these years he has been bugged, making him very easy. This recent patch actually fixed this bug, so he suddenly is very hard (as he was always intended to be). However since he is no longer a main elder boss, we lowered some of the mechanics that are now making him slightly too powerful.
[*]Fixed a bug where common level 1 gathering items could be found in the event zone.
[*]Fixed a bug where NPCs in the event zone were saying incorrect things about the outfits they were wearing.
[/LIST]

notes.title: Patch Notes 3.20.13
notes.notes:
This is a follow-up, fix-it build to the last patch.  We've also made some significant changes to the drop rates in the Equinox event zone.

[b] Improvements[/b] 
[LIST]
[*]Equinox Changes
[LIST]
[*]The chance of finding wings from a Pharaoh's chest: 1% -> 6%
[*]The chance of finding wings from a Caliph's chest: 0.4% -> 7%
[*]The chance of finding a Djinn Fairy Lamp in a Sand Darrig's chest: 0.5% -> 1.5%
[*]The chance of finding relic shards in a Darrig chest has remained the same, but when you do find them, you find more.
[*][B][U]Important note[/U]: We have heard and read lots of feedback about Equinox. Players do not like pure random luck! Let it be heard, let it be done! Spooky Town (and future event zones) will not rely on these luck mechanics (there may still be little luck mechanics here and there, but it won't be in this quantity or severity)[/B].
[/LIST]
[*]Warrior Feat Icons: Phoenix Strike and Whirlwind were updated to better convey their meanings
[/LIST]


[b] Bug Fixes[/b] 
[LIST]
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing bountiful watering pitchers to be sold for 1c. After this patch goes live,  bountiful watering pitchers that were obtained via this bug will be deleted from player inventories.
[*]Fixed: when using a ranged feat to target and attack an enemy, character would run towards the enemy.  Character now only runs to get into range required by the feat, no closer.
[LIST]
[*]Note that fixing this required reverting another fix, where using a feat with no spirit left would turn off auto-attack.
[/LIST]
[*]Fixed: doors would snap closed the moment they were opened.
[*]Fixed: jumping with Gnomish Jumping Boots stopped playing a flip animation due to a bug.
[*]Fixed: issues with chat tabs and party pane becoming messed up.
[*]Some players reported an error with the boss Zagreb. Turns out all these years he has been bugged, making him very easy. This recent patch actually fixed this bug, so he suddenly is very hard (as he was always intended to be). However since he is no longer a main elder boss, we lowered some of the mechanics that are now making him slightly too powerful.
[*]Fixed a bug where common level 1 gathering items could be found in the event zone.

notes.title: Patchnotes 3.20
notes.notes:
[IMG]https://giant.gfycat.com/MaleMintyAtlanticspadefish.gif[/IMG]

[h1][b]Patch 3.20.10[/b][/h1]

What is that strange sound?  Could it be...the whinny of a horse?  It is!!!

Mounts have, at long last, galloped into Villagers & Heroes!  And they brought Equinox with them!  And countless bug fixes!  And a slew of other exciting new features and improvements to the game!  

Happy Last Days of Summer, Everyone!  We hope you will all enjoy this hefty build.  :)

[B]Improvements[/B]
[LIST]
[*]New players now move 20% faster on foot.
[*]We have finally added [B]Mounts![/B] Players will now have the ability to access ride-able mounts. Mounts are special animals that can be ridden as a form of incredibly fast transportation, not to mention they look rather cool and are just plain fun to ride!
[LIST]
[*]All mounts come with a default move speed of 165%. This will set a players move speed to 165%, it cannot be boosted by any current in game effects.
[*]All mounts are permanent unlocks. The mount 'item' is a consumable, that once used will add that mount to your collection which will make it accessible forever.
[*]Mounts are character bound. Once unlocked, only that specific character will have access to the mount.
[*]Mounts can only be ridden while not in combat.
[*] [B]The Golden Bridle:[/B] This is a new shop item that will boost mounted speed to 185%. This item is a consumable, that once used will be character bound, lasts forever, and increases the speed on any mount you choose to ride. The Golden Bridle will be priced at 500 crowns.
[*][B]There are five unique mounts:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]The Grey Steed: 175 crowns
[*]The Bay Horse: 225 crowns
[*]The Nightmare: 350 crowns
[*]The Grey Wolf: 350 crowns
[*]The White Stallion: Can be found in Chests of the Red Darrig.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[*][B]Equinox Has Arrived![/B] The blazing sands of The Oases of Anuk ' Amon, a special event zone for players of any level where delicious challenges, fantastic rewards, and much camaraderie abound, has descended upon The Seven Realms!  
[LIST]
[*]All players have the opportunity to earn a special Equinox mount - 'The Sand Stallion!'
[*]All players have the opportunity to earn the exotic new outfit, 'Arabian Knight!'
[*]All players have the opportunity to earn six new Equinox-only outfit accessories!
[/LIST]
[*] We have made some exciting new changes to Gilly's Tunnel and Summer's Hollow -- A new combat hot spot! A completely re-designed portion of the zone!  Less talk, more action, and a much smoother flow to the starter quests in general! 
[LIST]
[*]Dialogue has been shortened, some npc's have been re-located or removed altogether, and some quest goals have also been removed.
[*]The 'backstage area' of the theater has had a cosmetic makeover, and you'll also find some lively new action there!  (Beware of Crazed Actors.)
[/LIST]
[*]We have added a new version of gardening water to the item shop: 'The Ancient Zharim Pitcher!'  This very special magical item will water your entire garden in a single action at the rate of Zharim water. There is also the "Bountiful Watering Pitcher" which waters the entire garden at the normal watering rate. It can be found from lucky cards, daily login bonuses, or Red Darrig Chests. 
[*]We've added new versions of Elixirs of Nurturing that have a 15 minute duration instead of 1 hour.
[*]We fixed some issues with lucky potions, and lucky finds in general. There was some confusion in how the information was displayed to the player regarding the stat of "Mega Loot" which was not fully accurate. We have cleaned this up so it is accurate, as well as made a few other improvements. Players may notice their Mega Loot chance appearing to drop in the stat window, but it in fact is now just being displayed correctly, whereas before it was not. 
[*]In addition to the changes in the system, we have also boosted the effectiveness of the item store item, "Elixir of Luck" by about 2.3x.
[*]We have added new 'Social Boosters.' These items will boost you, and every single player within range of you, whether that be 2 people, or 100. There is both a hero version, and a villager version. Each type gives a variety of bonuses, including XP gains, armor, damage, lucky find, supply find, and more. Each item can be used one time, will last for 20 minutes, and cost 60 crowns.
[*]We removed rare supplies from Gambling chests. We have added: Crystal of the Benevolent Hero, Crystal of the Benevolent Villager, Bountiful Watering Pitcher, and Ancient Zharim Pitcher.
[*]We have made it so the quantity of Red Doubloons found is much greater if you find them in a chest.
[*]If the game detects severe internet problems (for example, extremely long latencies or high packet loss rates), an icon will be shown prompting the player to check their connection.
[*]Improved Sounds:[LIST]
[*]Improved sounds for humans in the game, including male and female, player and not player.
[*]Made it so that during combat, the grunts and pains don't play quite as often.
[*]We made it so enemy alerts play on target player only. This will make it so players hear the sound when they are suppose to, and know when they are under attack.
[*]Monsters who are NPCs now play a sound matching their race
[*]Vendors now verbally greet the player[/LIST]
[*]Special offers for new characters are now supported on PC!  (Class Upgrade offers which contain a variety of boosts and unique outfits)
[/LIST]

[B]Bug Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Numerous tweaks were made to make tutorial popups better.
[*]Fixed: "Your kennel is full" message was changed to, "You cannot have more than 20 animals" to be more clear.
[*]Show icon when new talent points are available to make it easier to notice.
[*]Fixed: Ridgeline Gouger charter in Addicts Ascent
[*]Fixed some invisible fishing spots in Crystal Quarry.
[*]Fixed an issue with Removing Malog quest.
[*]Fixed some bad lighting in Cook Village.
[*]Fixed: Always allow a player to login, even when they are supposedly already logged in
[*]Made the Font larger in Quest Conversations with NPCs
[*]Fixed a weird movement spot in Ardent Castle Courtyard
[*]Fixed an issue where some bounties in Wizard Dorm were moving weirdly.
[*]Fixed an issue where players could use water gauntlets to move NPCs around.
[*]Fixed the oddly moving guard in Lady's Lake
[*]Fixed it so bug nodes in Mino Labs and Lair drop all kinds of bugs.
[*]Fixed underground mob in Badlands
[*]Fixed a dead spot in Undercroft.
[*]Gonzo is backed to his old self, and no longer a bounty.
[*]Fixed Typo: a letter her from Rhyming Rowena
[*]Fixed it so players can't fall beneath the dock near Dermot in Bearhold.
[*]Made Maiden a little less bright.
[*]Fixed the gathering area in Priest's Chambers to not be really dark.
[*]Fixed: tags show instead of bullets
[*]Fixed a stuck rock in Marigold.
[*]Fixed a stuck location in Sapphira's Lament
[*]Fixed a typo, Nuala, Fortunately.
[*]Fixed a case where the quest, "A Cure for Chaos" could get stuck if somehow you broke dialogue from Samuel after giving him the wings.
[*]Fixed an issue that made Steelforged Torc and Spellweavers Tailoring boost read "50%%"
[*]Because of the recent changes with COG distributors, we have made a few balancing tweaks to supply rates. Mostly, this is a slightly lowered amount of free daily supplies. The chance to find rare supplies while gathering has been very slightly tweaked as well.
[*]Fixed the "Meeting COG quest" to work again
[*]Removed mention of chicken zogs
[*]Fixed an issue where some hobgoblins wouldn't die.
[*]Fixed a case where a wilted gallyfern frond kept from a previous rebirth could bug out the next play through.
[*]Fixed a weird terrain glitch that could get players stuck in Addicts Ascent.
[*]We cleaned up some slightly misleading text concerning move speeds. Some effects and talents listed the movement bonus as a percent, when it was in fact a point boost. These have all been fixed.
[*]Fixed an issue that made the uncommon and rare supply distributors not have names or a marker over their head.
[*]We fixed a few typos and misleading texts concerning Chests of the Red Darrig
[*]Fixed some outfits that made accidental mention of Flynn McRufus in their description.
[*]Fixed: small area of dead space just above center bar (couldn't click through it, drag under it, etc.).
[*]"Spirit Essence" option is no longer shown in options (since it no longer does anything).
[*]Fixed: getting stuck while loading to character select. This has the side-effect of making two stats in Character Details become Unknown again.
[*]Fixed it so some low level elder bosses are now listed as elder bosses in the bounty journal.
[*]Fixed foretelling robe with Rickardi and only one cloth
[*]Fixed it so gathering water doesn't tick down Cornucopia charges.
[*]Made Contagion's skeletal hands a bit smaller.
[*]Fixed: using a feat when you do not have enough spirit no longer turns off auto-attack.
[*]Fixed: typo in tool tip
[*]Improved the goblin noises in Gilly Tunnel.
[*]Chauncey and Hugo both grew hair. Chauncey and Rhoda both got a tan.
[*]Minor: fixed small character oscillations when strafing.
[*]Moved some skitters away from the portal in Cronk.
[*]Moved some skitters away from Rosemunda.
[*]Fixed an issue with the quest "Fairy Ecology". Any player who was bugged with this quest may need to  kill a few more of each monster to make sure they are done with all of the goals.
[*]Fixed an issue where Tufts of Boar fur for Nadia would keep dropping after the quest was over.
[*]Fixed: Item expiration not working correctly - this was sometimes causing feats to disappear
[*]Minor: show a popup explaining the Grace of Celestia boost when players receive it from Mayor Gummel.
[*]Fixed: animations would got stuck in certain cases such as petting sheep.
[*]Fixed it so Rhoda only does the salsa dance.
[*]Fixed: enemies would sometimes not give normal (non-bounty) XP.
[*]Fixed: items sellable for Red Darrig coins would stack with ones that weren't, increasing or losing the coin value.
[*]Fixed a few issues with the Liches in Maldwyn's tomb: We removed the phylactery mechanic. While interesting, the mechanic had several bugs and caused some weirdness. Liches now just cast fire spells and die when you kill them. We also fixed some animation glitches that made the liches look funny, as well as a floating sword hovering beneath them. All of these fixes combine should make it so Liches don't go Aegis all the time.
[*]We made damage over time effects (from Spider and Rat poisons) do less damage in the tutorial zones.
[*]Fixed some issues in Dagmar fields that might increase FPS for lower end systems.
[*]We updated several spell, feat, and talent icons across all classes (updating older icons and removing a few of the more graphic icons).
[*]We made some changes to a few movement speed modifiers to balance with mounts:[LIST]
[*]Elixirs of Speed (Item Shop): removed from the shop, lucky cards, daily login bonus, and Chests of the Red Darrig. Players will still keep whatever they have however the item will remain unchanged.
[*]Fleetindra: Movement bonus was reduced to 15% (from 30%), but now also affects mounted speed. Now only works outside of combat.
[*]Light Footed (House Buff): Now only works outside of combat. Now also boosts mounted speed.
[*]Celestia's Swiftness (Spirit Essence): Reduced from 15% to 10%. Now also affects mounted speed.
[*]Vengeful Dash (Wobbles Remedy): Reduced from 25% to 15%. Now also affects mounted speed. Only works outside of combat.[/LIST]
[*]Fixed: player can sometimes oscillate and jump about while teleporting.
[*]Fixed a rock that could get you stuck in Marigold Harbor.
[*]Fixed a Stamina plant that was hard to reach in Bevyn's Coille.
[*]Fixed a bad fruit tree in Goldenvale.
[*]Fixed it so repair globules have tooltips again.
[*]Fixed it so rebirth's don't reset your zog redemption.
[*]Fixed it so Lunar Horn doesn't drop unless the player is on the quest.
[*]Fixed the quest "Pigment Mixer" to correctly say 'four'.
[*]Fixed it so the quest Crystalgestion correctly tracks back to Yori.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused fireball to do less damage than intended.
[*]Fixed an issue that made later versions of Mayor Gummel bounce around.
[*]Fixed some quest text in the 'Meeting Cog' quest that may have mislead players as to what to do.
[*]Fixed the vendor window to now correctly display certain text tags.
[/LIST]

[B]Mobile[/B] (currently available for Android in the UK and Scandinavia)

[IMG]https://giant.gfycat.com/ImmenseOnlyFossa.gif[/IMG]

[B]New: Informative loading screens[/B][LIST]
[*]The zone-based loading screens have been replaced with a selection of polished, informative screens showcasing game features and providing tips and tricks.[/LIST]
[B]New: Mail[/B][LIST]
[*]You can now send mail to other players, providing a way to send messages and transfer/trade items.
[*]The Mail window is added in place of the System window which is now removed.[/LIST]
[B]New: Parties[/B][LIST]
[*]You can now party up with other players to see them on the map and share XP rewards. This works seamlessly with the PC version.
[*]When in a party, you can see the names and health of other party members on the HUD.[/LIST]
[B]Updated: Better HUD[/B][LIST]
[*]Bars and talent buttons are now always visible by default.
[*]XP bar now fills the entire width of the screen, making it easier to see XP progress. Newly gained XP is also in a different color so you can see how much XP you just got.
[*]Health and Spirit bars are redesigned to be clearer and look better.
[*]There is now a level indicator directly on the HUD.
[*]There is now visual feedback for being low on health.
[*]There is now visual feedback for activating feats.
[*]Added a mount button.
[*]Action button has new icons, is larger, and is redesigned to look clearer.
[*]General HUD fixes and improvements.[/LIST]
[B]Updated: Better NPC dialogue UI[/B][LIST]
[*]When talking to NPCs, the camera now zooms in on the NPC - showing the character you are talking to better, and providing a better UI for reading/selecting replies.
[*]NPCs now have animations during dialogue.[/LIST]
[B]Other mobile fixes and improvements[/B][LIST]
[*]Fixed: No notification was shown when harvesting, and twice too many messages were shown when gathering from animals.
[*]Vendor slider is now weighted towards the low end, making it much easier to select an exact number of items to buy or sell.
[*]After creating a character, they are selected by default on the Character Se
[*]Quest exclamations are now shown at a further distance to make them easier to find.
[*]'Experience gained' notifications now show your level.
[*]Notifications are no longer covered by gathering/crafting/consumable progress bars.
[*]When whispering to another player, you now see who you whispered to in the chat log.
[*]Made some minor tweaks and fixes for tutorial popups.
[*]Fixed misalignment for popup arrows.
[*]Increased time that chats are shown on game screen.
[*]If a container only has one item, pick it up right away instead of showing container window.
[*]Added support for resetting your account's password.
[*]Fixed minor misalignment between HUD chat arrow and bubble.
[*]Fixed issue preventing resurrect potions from being bought on the death screen.
[*]Notification icon is now shown over shop button when there is a new sale or offer.
[*]Show icon when new talent points are available to make it easier to notice.
[*]Fixed: Sometimes keyboard would cover bottom of chat list.
[*]Minor fixes and polish to chat screen.
[*]Window close button is now an X rather than a down arrow.
[*]Fixed: "Whisper to" and action button didn't set up whisper correctly.
[*]Don't show "Keyboard controls must be reset" on tablet.
[*]Tapping-and-holding a button with a menu (such as feat buttons on the HUD) will now show the menu immediately when having held down for long enough, rather than require you to let go.
[*]Preview button in the item shop is now 50% invisible when there is no preview, for clarity.
[/LIST]

[B]Misc.[/B]
[LIST]
[*]We have removed Celestia's Helm and Boots from the item shop, as well as the Celestia's Helm starter offer
[/LIST]

[*]We updated several spell, feat, and talent icons across all classes (updating older icons and removing a few of the more graphic icons).
[*]We made some changes to a few movement speed modifiers to balance with mounts:[LIST]
[*]Elixirs of Speed (Item Shop): removed from the shop, lucky cards, daily login bonus, and Chests of the Red Darrig. Players will still keep whatever they have however the item will remain unchanged.
[*]Fleetindra: Movement bonus was reduced to 15% (from 30%), but now also affects mounted speed. Now only works outside of combat.
[*]Light Footed (House Buff): Now only works outside of combat. Now also boosts mounted speed.
[*]Celestia's Swiftness (Spirit Essence): Reduced from 15% to 10%. Now also affects mounted speed.
[*]Vengeful Dash (Wobbles Remedy): Reduced from 25% to 15%. Now also affects mounted speed. Only works outside of combat.[/LIST]
[*]Fixed: player can sometimes oscillate and jump about while teleporting.
[*]Fixed a rock that could get you stuck in Marigold Harbor.
[*]Fixed a Stamina plant that was hard to reach in Bevyn's Coille.
[*]Fixed a bad fruit tree in Goldenvale.
[*]Fixed it so repair globules have tooltips again.
[*]Fixed it so rebirth's don't reset your zog redemption.
[*]Fixed it so Lunar Horn doesn't drop unless the player is on the quest.
[*]Fixed the quest "Pigment Mixer" to correctly say 'four'.
[*]Fixed it so the quest Crystalgestion correctly tracks back to Yori.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused fireball to do less damage than intended.
[*]Fixed an issue that made later versions of Mayor Gummel bounce around.
[*]Fixed some quest text in the 'Meeting Cog' quest that may have mislead players as to what to do.
[*]Fixed the vendor window to now correctly display certain text tags.
[/LIST]

[B]Mobile[/B] (currently available for Android in the UK and Scandinavia)

[IMG]https://giant.gfycat.com/ImmenseOnlyFossa.gif[/IMG]

[B]New: Informative loading screens[/B][LIST]
[*]The zone-based loading screens have been replaced with a selection of polished, informative screens showcasing game features and providing tips and tricks.[/LIST]
[B]New: Mail[/B][LIST]
[*]You can now send mail to other players, providing a way to send messages and transfer/trade items.
[*]The Mail window is added in place of the System window which is now removed.[/LIST]
[B]New: Parties[/B][LIST]
[*]You can now party up with other players to see them on the map and share XP rewards. This works seamlessly with the PC version.
[*]When in a party, you can see the names and health of other party members on the HUD.[/LIST]
[B]Updated: Better HUD[/B][LIST]
[*]Bars and talent buttons are now always visible by default.
[*]XP bar now fills the entire width of the screen, making it easier to see XP progress. Newly gained XP is also in a different color so you can see how much XP you just got.
[*]Health and Spirit bars are redesigned to be clearer and look better.
[*]There is now a level indicator directly on the HUD.
[*]There is now visual feedback for being low on health.
[*]There is now visual feedback for activating feats.
[*]Added a mount button.
[*]Action button has new icons, is larger, and is redesigned to look clearer.
[*]General HUD fixes and improvements.[/LIST]
[B]Updated: Better NPC dialogue UI[/B][LIST]
[*]When talking to NPCs, the camera now zooms in on the NPC - showing the character you are talking to better, and providing a better UI for reading/selecting replies.
[*]NPCs now have animations during dialogue.[/LIST]
[B]Other mobile fixes and improvements[/B][LIST]
[*]Fixed: No notification was shown when harvesting, and twice too many messages were shown when gathering from animals.
[*]Vendor slider is now weighted towards the low end, making it much easier to select an exact number of items to buy or sell.
[*]After creating a character, they are selected by default on the Character Se
[*]Quest exclamations are now shown at a further distance to make them easier to find.
[*]'Experience gained' notifications now show your level.
[*]Notifications are no longer covered by gathering/crafting/consumable progress bars.
[*]When whispering to another player, you now see who you whispered to in the chat log.
[*]Made some minor tweaks and fixes for tutorial popups.
[*]Fixed misalignment for popup arrows.
[*]Increased time that chats are shown on game screen.
[*]If a container only has one item, pick it up right away instead of showing container window.
[*]Added support for resetting your account's password.
[*]Fixed minor misalignment between HUD chat arrow and bubble.
[*]Fixed issue preventing resurrect potions from being bought on the death screen.
[*]Notification icon is now shown over shop button when there is a new sale or offer.
[*]Show icon when new talent points are available to make it easier to notice.
[*]Fixed: Sometimes keyboard would cover bottom of chat list.
[*]Minor fixes and polish to chat screen.
[*]Window close button is now an X rather than a down arrow.
[*]Fixed: "Whisper to" and action button didn't set up whisper correctly.
[*]Don't show "Keyboard controls must be reset" on tablet.
[*]Tapping-and-holding a button with a menu (such as feat buttons on the HUD) will now show the menu immediately when having held down for long enough, rather than require you to let go.
[*]Preview button in the item shop is now 50% invisible when there is no preview, for clarity.
[/LIST]

[B]Misc.[/B]
[LIST]
[*]We have removed Celestia's Helm and Boots from the item shop, as well as the Celestia's Helm starter offer
[/LIST]

notes.title: Introducing Mounts and faster base move speed!
notes.notes:
[img=https://giant.gfycat.com/MaleMintyAtlanticspadefish.gif]

Tired of trudging arduously around seemingly endless zones on your aching, weary, virtual feet? Ever wish longingly to be seated upon a magnificent white stallion, who, with head raised, tail swishing, and hooves pounding, swiftly gallops its owner across the vast and beautiful landscape of this mystical land?

[img=https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Villagers%20%26%20Heroes/mounts_lineup.png]

If so, then wish no more, because not only have mounts, of varying shapes, colors, and sizes, cantered into Villagers & Heroes in all their majestic glory, but with them, too, they bring the always challenging and wondrous event zone known as Equinox! So saddle up players! Don your swirling Sheik robes, sharpen your weaponry, and ride into the blazing desert sands of The Oases of Anuk ‘Amon, where insidious Pharaohs, dazzling rewards, and great adventure await all those who venture forth!

And, [b]even without mounts, everyone's base move speed has been increased from the previous reduction![/b] Hopefully this will resolve issues some of you have been having with movement feeling too slow and floaty.

This update will be live very soon - until then, stay tuned for more news!

For more information on mounts, Equinox and much more, see the all-new Ardent Monthly Ledger!

http://www.villagersandheroes.com/issue-21/

notes.title: Patch 3.19.3
notes.notes:
[h1] Patch Notes 3.19.3[/h1] 

With this build comes the removal of The Twilight Vale, but we do have some exciting new improvements for you all (gambling chests!) and the always needed bug fixes.  :)


[h1] Improvements[/h1] 
[LIST]
[*]New feature: Chests of the Red Darrig![LIST]
[*][*]Chests of the Red Darrig are new items to the game. Players can open a chest of the red darrig for a chance at great rewards. Chests may contain:[LIST]
[*][b]Powerful Consumables:[/b] May contain powerful items from the shop, or even exclusive rare and powerful potions.
[*][b]Expansive Outfits:[/b] May contain just about any outfit in the Seven Realms, even those out of season, or otherwise unavailable!
[*][b]Red Doubloons:[/b] These special coins can be used to purchase items from Flynn McRufus in Ardent City.[/LIST]
[*]Any item that is found in a Chest of the Red Darrig can be sold to a new vendor, Flynn McRufus in Ardent City (up by the castle), for his currency, Red Doubloons. Using this currency, players can collect outfits, special items, and rare consumables.
[*][B]Chests can be gained in one of two ways:[/B][LIST]
[*]Chests will be sold in the shop, 10 crowns each (or 10 for 90 crowns).
[*]Locked chests can also be found in the world as rare drops from monsters. However to open a locked chest, you'll need a key.
[*][*]Keys can also be found in the world as rare drops from enemies, but can also be purchased from the shop for 6 crowns each (or 10 for 50 crowns).[/LIST][/LIST]
[*]Spirit Essences have received an overhaul[LIST]
[*]Spirit essence are the consumables the drop from monsters that give players a short effects (what used to be the lightning bolt, hammer, etc.)
[*]All existing Spirit essences have been renamed with more flavorful names.
[*]Spirit essences have much improved art, both the 3d model that appears in the world, and the following icon.
[*]Spirit essences now make cool and powerful sounds and visual effects when you consume one.
[*]We have balanced a few of the spirit essences, making sure any single one wasn't too powerful.
[*]We have added 7 additional types of Spirit Essences, all with their own unique effect. Some give health, spirit, speed, lucky chance, and more![/LIST]
[*]New character rewards! Bonus items are given to new characters during the first seven days of play.
[*]Removed the in-game video
[*]Removed The Twilight Vale
[/LIST]


[h1] Bug Fixes[/h1] 
[LIST]
[*]Updated the Village COG depot to reflect recent changes. Now instead of the 4 different suppliers (who are now only 1), the village project goes as follows:
[LIST]
[*]Rank 1: A normal daily COG Supplier
[*]Rank 2: A COG quartermaster (vendor) appears
[*]Rank 3: A Quality COG Distributor will move into your village. This special distributor will give out an uncommon supply crate once every 2 days. Uncommon supply crates contain varying amounts of one random uncommon gathering supply.
[*]Rank 4: A Rare COG Distributor will move into your village. This special distributor will give out a rare supply crate once every 3 days. Rare supply crates contain varying amounts of one random rare gathering supply.
[/LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue where you could end up with the quest Sheep Minus one forever
[*]Typo: Fortunatley with
[*]Fixed: Vault windows did not automatically close after certain distance
[*]Fixed it so the sell gems button doesn't appear when the vendor doesn't use gold as a currency.
[*]Fixed: some items would erroneously warn that they had their soulbinding stripped and would soulbind if equipped, even though the item could not soulbind.
[*]Fixed the Pumpkin Carver to drop again (it now drops from Redcaps in Maiden).
[*]Fixed the quest 'Looting the Lexicon' to be the correct level
[*]Rickardi gives enough fleece for Anointed Sandals now.
[*]Updated the quest level for "The Purge"
[*]Fixed some quests texts that should have directed the player to Gandymeade Grove.
[*]Fixed: Lucky Cards weren't being given at the correct interval.
[*]Fixed it so no more 'gnomish' items drop
[*]Fixed: Purchased Items would sometimes take a while to update after purchasing an item.
[*]Server exceptions related to moodscript
[*]Made the Zog crown bag and Zog elixir bag both account bound instead of character bound.
[*]Updated Reaper's pack to correctly show the 600 crown value of the tool set.
[*]Fixed: number of points needed not visible after partially doing task
[*]Fix some issues causing feat selection menu to be clunky to use.
[*]Tutorial Pop-Up Timeouts
[*]Fixed Typo: tranparency should be transparency.
[*]Support for global message to all players
[*]Fixed: spirit essences and items would woosh into bag and player twice.
[*]Updated the Oak Valley quest that used Mega Looters to now use Luckinium instead.
[*]Fixed it so level 80 gathering nodes correctly drop lucky gems.
[*]Fixed a typo: Talking talking
[*]Fixed an issue where the quest to kill Kobolds in Gilly cavern wasn't tracking on the map.
[*]Fixed a bug where the tutorial cooking quests were giving out unneeded silks.
[*]Fixed a bug causing undead in Shiverspine not to drop 'Prime Ribs'
[*]Fixed the vendor gui to support more than 3 characters for larger sales and purchases.
[*]3.18.3 Test - windows - Xanty - unearthed sailor is under the ground
[*]Fixed it so level 1 crafting tools work in the item browser.
[*]Class Starter Pack Changes
[*]Fixed a stuck spot in Bearhold Valley.
[*]Fixed: floating bush
[*]Fixed: floating bush
[*]Update libpng to newer version
[*]Fixed: entries in knowledge book remained stuck in "Click to reveal discovery" and could not be clicked to reveal.
[*]Fixed some issues with the Meeting COG quest
[*]Fixed an issue that made chest objects sometimes not have items.
[*]Fixed some bright sand in the Traven region
[*]Fixed some issues with fishing nodes in Cook Cavern.
[*]Fixed a stuck log in Barbing Rock
[*]Fixed a stuck location in a rock in Dagmar Strand
[*]Fixed: selling an entire stack of items would get hung on "Transacting..."
[/LIST]
