notes.title: Patch Notes 3.1.1 (part 1)
notes.notes:
[h1]Gathering Changes[/h1]
[list]
      [*]  Boosted Mote of Yorick drop chance across the board
           [*] Base chance: boosted from 5% to 15%
           [*] Hasty Herb Chance: boosted from 0.5%-5% (level 1, level 75) to 3%-9%.
           [*] Normal Herb Chance: boosted from 1.5%-15% (level 1, level 75) to 7%-21%
           [*] Yorick's Jewlery: boosted from 4%-20% to 5%-26%
           [*] Gold price dropped from 14s 95c to 12s 95c.
           [*] Changed it so if you have Mote Find greater than 100%, you get a chance at a second Mote of Yorick.
           [*] Cornucopia have been boosted. Instead of 3 charges at 90%, they now contain 5 charges a 100%. All charter variations are rebalanced to take this into account. The chance to find them is now slightly more rare (0.5%)
           [*] Gathering hats now also increases the chance to find Motes of Yorick by 15%. With the new base mote chance of 15%, this doubles a hat wearers chances to find Motes of Yorick.
      [*]  We have removed all ranks of supplies (ranks being the level ranges). Instead all supplies of a gathering skill will work at any level node.
           [*] We kept all the rarities of supplies (common, superior, premium).
           [*] We have added two new types of supplies: No trade superior and No trade premium. These items will work just like normal superior and premium supplies, but they will be separate items (including a different name and a different icon).
       [*] This will leave a total of five items per gathering skill:
            [*] Common Supplies (No Trade)
            [*] Superior Supplies (No Trade)
            [*] Premium Supplies (No Trade)
            [*] Superior Supplies (Trade-able)
            [*] Premium Supplies (Trade-able)
       [*] In total this will be 20 item (5 items * 4 skills) compared to 48 items from the old system (4 ranks * 3 rarities * 4 skills). That is 28 items less.
       [*] This is where and how you will acquire these items:
           [*] Common Supplies (No Trade): Can be found while gathering, Will be given out by daily distributors, can be purchased with COG coins.
           [*] Superior Supplies (No Trade): Can be purchased using COG coins.
           [*] Premium Supplies (No Trade): Can be purchased using COG coins.
           [*] Superior Supplies (Tradable): Can be found while gathering.
           [*] Premium Supplies (Tradable): Can be found while gathering, can be purchased using charter tokens.
       [*] All COG values (buy / sell / trade) have been adjusted to fit the new system.
           [*] COG patrons will now accept any type of supply in exchange for COG coins (common, superior, premium, superior (no trade), premium (no trade)).
           [*] A Note on this:[i] All five can go in, but only three can come out. This means any of the five supply types listed above can be traded to a COG patron, but only the three no trade versions can by purchased using COG coins. Consequently, players can never take a trade-able supply, trade it with COG, and get a trade-able supply back out. The COG patron will give you a special warning about this issue.[/i]
       [*] Common Supplies will no longer be sold for Gold.
       [*] COG coins can now be purchased with Gold.
       [*] Transition from old types to new types:
           [*] All old supply types will be converted to new types by the system when the build goes live.
           [*] Any unopened bounty salvage, charter bags, or daily bags, will now contain the new type of item.
           [*] If somehow a player still has an old item type after the build goes live, that item will still work for gathering.
       [*] Xinzen carp were balanced to take into account the new changes.
       [*] Normal Herbs that give the Abundant Earth effect, now last for 20 minutes rather than 5. Hasty herb duration remains the same.
       [*] Bounties no longer drop Bounty Salvage. Instead bounties will give COG coins based on the level of the bounty.
       [*] COG coins now stack to 9500 (used to be 5000)
       [*] When a character first gathers with no supplies selected, a tutorial message appears.
[/list]


  [h1]  Improvements [/h1]
[list]
      [*]  We made the X that indicates an item cannot be used smaller and less aggressive
      [*]  Made Mail text and Auction House quantity text easier to read.
      [*]  The "Mail" button was moved into the top-left HUD frame, and now flashes when new mail is received, as it did before Reborn.
      [*]  The dark background behind the crafting window, friends window, and all the other windows has been removed, allowing you to chat and move items about while the windows are open.
      [*]  Changed "Social" to "Friends"
      [*]  When a character first gathers with no supplies selected, show a tutorial popup.
[/list]

notes.title: Review of Villagers and Heroes: Reborn
notes.notes:
Check out this review from [b][i]Inventory Full[/i][/b]:

[url=http://bhagpuss.blogspot.com/2015/06/here-we-go-again-villagers-and-heroes.html] Inventory Full Review [/url]

A few excerpts:
"All the time you're on the character creation screen some plummy-voiced old thesp chats away in the background. He seems to have an agenda of some kind, or possibly a grudge. Maybe against you. It gave the whole thing a vaguely sinister, off-color air that I liked a lot. I wouldn't trust him to get me a donut from the commissary, I know that much."

"V&H also has by far the best random name generator I have ever seen. I spent about fifteen minutes just playing with it. It brings up a huge variety of names in a range of formats - ordinary one-word names like Norman or Rose, forename and surname pairs, portentous titles, typical fantasy gibberish, surreal combinations and straightforward names you might imagine working alongside in an insurance office...I almost went with Katie Buck Mutton. I could feel her character coming through so strongly just from that name. Too strongly. I thought she might just take me over. I plumped for something plain and simple and in I went."

"I found myself caught up in the main storyline rather easily. Just what did failed Mayoral candidate Rhoda drop into the spooky old well after dark? What made Clementine deClancy vanish? What do the blood symbols on the note Chauncey's brother found mean?"

notes.title: Patch 3.03
notes.notes:
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
   [*] The pauses that were occurring when players were running around have been (mostly) removed. There may still be some pauses, but it should be much better. This fix also helps the fly over that plays upon entering Ethos the first time, and load times for all zones were generally improved.
[/list]



[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
   [*] Motes of Yorick no longer drop from water gathering.
   [*] Fixed: gathering with supplies took longer than intended because it was not counting the beginning of the animation (throwing the fishing line, crouching to look at bugs, etc.) in the time. In particular, gathering with Common Supplies was intended to take about three seconds from beginning of animation to getting items, but could take five seconds depending on the animation.
  [*]  Fixed: trying to use an item after gnogmenting would say "You are busy".
 [*]   Fixed a bug causing feats, stats, and combat in general to get broken after a Mummy casts Wither on you.
      [*]  Hopefully that also fixes this: Sometimes the health orb glitches and I have more or less health than It displays. Same with the exp bar. (https://forum.villagersandheroes.com...l=1#post102913)
  [*]  Garden Items and Water will now stack to 1000
  [*]  Fixed a floating lamp at-279 -219 62 in Lower Ethos Island
  [*]  Fixed some hidden bug nodes in the village
  [*]  Fixed gathering nodes in Oak Valley to drop the correct level item.
  [*]  Fixed the quest Understanding the Understudy, certain players were getting stuck getting eggs for Hubert (some players might have seen this when they were trying to help carwen gathering gum)
  [*]  Fixed Lady Phillipa to finish your quest if you cancel her dialog in the middle.
  [*]  Fixed it so if you lose your salamander soap, Penelope will give you another.
  [*]  Fixed Clotilde asking for Honey Damselfish.
  [*]  Fixed Yoricks Hat so it wasn't gathering at a 3x rate
   [*] We increased respawns- hopefully spiders, etc., respawn more frequently
  [*]  Fixed a bug causing a crash for certain players when they click on the chat box.
  [*]  Hopefully fixed a bug causing a crash for certain players with older graphics cards when they tried to enter the character create screen.
  [*]  Fixed issues where, after a rebirth, quests and bounties are weird and don't work properly until you relog.
  [*]  Fixed a number of issues related to shared vault, such as account-bound items not being able to be dropped in it, items disappearing after being put in shared vault until a relog, etc. We believe this will also fix issues with vim shards disappearing or moving about until a relog.
      [*]  No-trade items can be put in shared vault client-side (slot shows green) but server rejects it and item disappears.
       [*] Shared items can't be put in shared vault (slot shows red), unless you put it in vault first.
       [*] Shared vault eats items -- server rejects and item disappears.
   [*] Fixed: right ring can't be equipped using drag-and-drop (slot turns red).
   [*] Updated the Legacy version (no longer available) of the Elf's Hat so it works in the new system.
  [*]  All starter outfits are now No Trade
   [*] Updated the sale price for the Crystallized Vim Shard (it has been lowered)
   [*] Fixed it so the next patch to live will convert: Vim Regen Candies, lollygrams that contain a grape lollypop, any grape lollypops that may have been opened since Monday morning, and vim boosters.
  [*]  Increased the spawn rate of certain monsters and bounties in the starter areas.
[/list]


Note: We have not been able to reproduce the problem where sending mail causes a disconnection or any problems. We're still working on it.

(Oxiras own note: Sorry I was late with posting this, I've been under the weather recently.)

notes.title: REBORN Patch Notes - Part 4
notes.notes:
[b](continued from part 3)[/b]

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]fixed: Quizmato doesn't wear the guide outfit like Quizmay and Quizmo.
[*]fixed: At 760 158 97 in Keppel Cavern there is a hump/barrier in the narrow path that you cannot get past.
[*]fixed: 189 -324 133 in Crystal Spire -- a player can accidentally drop into this spot and become stuck inside rocks.
[*]fixed: When you take the Drom teleporter TO the Antler vendor, it often places you on an extremely precarious ledge.
[*]Npcs no longer wander and get stuck on objects (Npcs like Eumendese, Mary, Rando, Olimpias, etc.).
[*]Fixed a bug with certain monsters effects being more powerful than they should against liberty drams?
[*]Fixed:Kriemhild in Daggertooth Pits refers to 10 gold; it should be 10 copper.
[*]Fixed: At 72 -94 192 in Shadow Fated Traven, the teleporter is floating above the ground.
[*]Fixed: At -83 -47 347 in Cook Cavern, two trees are really floating!
[*]Fixed: Sidhes Are paralyzed, one of the Banshee NPC's are missing. Note: Cassandra is now fixed (though she does move). And those sidhes are babies, they don't attack.
[*]Various Quest typos fixed.
[*]Fixed the funny looking tree in Ardent near the Starry Night statue.
[*]Fixed: When weapons are worn on a toon's back, they partially disappear into the toon.
[*]Fixed: Movement when revived from death (with or without wobbles). When you revive (especially if you don't use a resurrect ball), movement is random. If you tell the toon to go forward, it might go to the left...or to the right...or backwards...sometimes right through a portal.
[*]Fixed: keys (such as A, D, ctrl, alt, etc.) could sometimes get 'stuck', causing a spinning movement of camera and requiring those keys to be pressed again to make the spinning stop.
[*]Fixed: window could be re-sized to any size while loading.
[*]Removed the "Museum of Antiquities" sign
[*]Fixed:You can mine from inside the rock at 518 -132 186 in Kiwa.
[*]Fixed: Mobs killed near 277 6 155 in Isle Rega drop their loot in a rock and you cannot retrieve it. Note: This was a problem with the collision mesh, you could actually physically pass into the rock here.
[*]Fixed some but not all cases of the Camera Jitters
[*]Fixed: Animation for angel wings is glitched on players' toons.
[*]Fixed: closing dialog from an NPC, then rapidly selecting another NPC, could cause your character to get confused and unable to interact until after deselecting the NPC.
    Fixed: in-game bug reporting would always fail.
[/list]


[h1][b]Other Notes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Turned off the Easter Eggs
[*]Turned off the Sugarsweet Summit Event Zone
[/list]


[h1][b]Known Problems[/b][/h1]
These are problems we are aware of, and we are working to fix as quickly as possible.

[list]
[*]The narrated fly-over that new characters see the first time they enter Ethos Island is choppy. This is not a problem with your computer, but a problem we are working on.
[*]We know that some players with Item gear like Kangaroo Boots and Golden Winged Helm may have gnogmented some of the special abilities from this gear onto high level gear, and that when they do a Rebirth, they will have a difficult choice of either a) not having access to those abilities after the Rebirth or b) moving the abilities to new low level gear (and losing the high level gear). We are aware of this problem and we are working on a solution quickly.
[*]Character height is affecting the run speed (it should not!)
[*]Some of the User Interface still needs a make-over, most especially the Knowledge Book.
[*]The crafting stations still reference Vim.
[*]It is almost impossible to go up on this ramp. << You are at 831 -543 50 in Lower Ethos Island>>... The other ramp is fine, but this one has some sort of invisible something that keeps you from walking forward.
[*]On Live, If you press shift + Z you can view FPS and ping, but on Test pressing it won't show anything now.
[*]Viperous Viceroy Quest: the Salamander's Soap quest item can be thrown away, and it is not returned when you talk to the npc again.
[*]The camera jitters when you back your character up into a cliff or a wall.
[*]Auto-Attack Bug: It's not always being activated automatically.
[*]The blinking mail notification is not working
[*]After you do a Rebirth, Quests are not re-activated until you log out and log back in.
[*]It's not possible to Chat when the Crafting Window is open.
[*]Sometimes a player cannot plant a certain square in their garden.
[*]Weapon with drag and drop in bag is very large while it's being dragged
[*]K opens skills now, not talents.
[*]Odd things happen when I try to equip a priest of warrior shield. It acts like it equips the shield, then the shield turns translucent in my inventory and it can't interact with it any more, It doesn't show as equipped on my outfit screen, but i can't move it or delete it out of my inventory any more.
[/list]

notes.title: REBORN Patch Notes - Part 3
notes.notes:
[b](continued from part 2)[/b]

[list]
[h1][b]Lake Kiwa[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: Vim tutorial.
[*]New System: Gathering Safe Haven. All Vim tutorials have been temporarily removed, and will be replaced with gathering strategy tutorial system in the future. COG representatives are present at Lake Kiwa.

[h1][b]Purchased Hats - Aggrandize[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: Increased max vim by 20-30
[*]New System: Increases chance to recycle (not use) supplies.

[/list]

[b]If Vim is gone, does that mean I can craft endlessly?[/b] Yes. As long as you have the mats, you can craft for as long as you want. There is no gate.

[b]Will crafting use supplies?[/b] No. Supplies are used only in the gathering skills.

[b]What happens to golden tools in this new system?[/b] No change whatsoever. Golden tools yield the exact same results as before.


[h1][b]Art Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Made the female and male player hands smaller
[*]Improved many of the female faces and heads
[*]Improved the World Map
[*]Improved some of the local maps
[*]Made the trees look nicer (for the art techies, added custom normals to make them appear fuller). Also gave them a better texture.
[/list]
[h1][b]GUI Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]"Shop Vault" was renamed to "Shop Items".
[*]Added a total stack value to the tool-tips that tells you the selling price for the entire stack of items
[*]Quick action bars on the inventory window can now have bound hotkeys.
[/list]
[h1][b]Misc Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved Gardening rarities: Improved the rarity system of crops to help differentiate between different types (magical vs common, or hasty vs. normal)
[*]Added a Reflection slider to Settings->Graphics. Note: even on the second notch, reflections have a big impact on frame rate. Only on Extreme are they enabled by default, and even then not at the highest setting. However, if you have a fantastic graphics card, you could try moving reflections to the max.
[*]Improved the Stinging Blasio and Jabs daily quests
[*]The Villagers & Heroes 'Game Guide' on the web site has been updated, and now reflects all changes made within the past year, as well as new info for pre-existing sections.
[/list]
[h1][b]Graphics Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Boosted the frame rate by over 50%!
[*]Reflections now are ON when a player selects Extreme for graphics setting.
[*]Reflections no longer reflect everything in the scene - just the big stuff. (Reflections in the water now reflect the sky, the mountains, the clouds, but not all the creatures and trees. * This improves the frame rate.)
[*]Changed minimum res to 960x760
[*]The camera avoids fewer objects, leading to fewer jarring camera movements.
[/list]
[h1][b]Playbalance Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Reduced the amount of lucky gems that drop by but increased their sell value. Players will see a lot less gems popping out of gathering nodes and mob deaths, but because of the increased sale price the gold received by the player will be a perfect wash.
[*]We increased health regeneration when not in combat by 2.3x.
[*]We reduced crafting XP Requirements by a significant amount at the higher levels (so it will be a little easier to keep crafting levels equal to combat level).
[*]Because of this, several of the higher level recipes (levels 40+) will also change as well, lowering the base amount of refined materials needed.
[/list]
[h1][b]Pyrron Playbalance and Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Medallion Balancing: Addressing issues that we have heard from the community, we took a pass at the Pyrrus Medallion system, attempting to make it a bit easier and less of a grind.
[*]Added: Sapphirra's Lament, Pyrron Courtyard, Lower Keep, and Pyrron Mezzanine, now all drop Obsidian Medallions.
[*]Lowered: Bastion and Ramparts key prices have been lowered from 300 to 200 Obsidian Medallions
[*]Changed: Bastion and Ramparts no longer drop Obsidian Medallions, but instead drop Malachite Medallions.
[*]Lowered: Undercroft and Apothecary prices have been lowered from 700 to 325 Obsidian Medallions
[*]Lowered: Underbelly and Creation Caves have been lowered from 325 to 200 Malachite Medallions
[*]Changed: Underbelly and Creation Caves no longer drop Malachite Medallions, but instead drop Carnelian Medallions
[*]Added: Creation Caves, being a difficult zone to navigate, now has double medallion drops (all bounties drop 2 medallions).
[*]Lowered: Armory and Staging chambers have been lowered from 725 to 325 Malachite Medallions
[*]Lowered: Key to Keppel Cavern has been lowered from 750 to 600 Carnellian Medallions

[*]Pyrrick Acorns
[*]Pyrrick Acorns can now by purchased using any of the Pyrron Medallions types. Visit the Goblin vendors in Sapphiras Lament to see specific pricings.
[*]Drop rates on acorns has been increased slightly

[*]Stone Steps
[*]All Insurgent gear (rings, belts, and gloves that removes the stone step effects) have had their minimum level restriction reduced by two levels each.
[*]All Insurgent gear has had its gold value reduced by half.
[*]Stone Steps no longer nullifies all speed boost modifiers, but instead reduces any bonuses you do have, never reducing the player below default movement speed.
[*]Note: There will be no compensation for players who have already played through these zones with old stone steps effect.

[*]Zone Brightening: We have heard players mention that several of the cavernous Pyrrus zone feel too dark and gloomy. We want to take an attempt at making these zones more fun to be in (this does not affect the dungeon type environments).
[/list]
[h1][b]Low Level Zones - General Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved the Following Zones by adjusting the levels of the monsters and the quests and art improvements: Ardent City, Elk Meadow, Ardent Castle, Southern Coast, Kingsport, Shadow's Den (new zone!), Oak Valley, Villages, Mounds, Vinton, Bearhold Valley, Addict's Ascent, Cook Village, Traders Path, Green Gate, Sirens Course, Bearhold Crypt, Forgotten Reservoir, Southern Marsh, Zombie Town
[*]Old Summer's Hollow and Oak Valley have been visually updated and re-purposed to fit as level 15 and level 20 zones. Players might see a few familiar faces.
[*]Elk Shadow has moved from Elk Meadow. He found a new home...
[/list]
[h1][b]Portal Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]The portal to Maiden and back is now accessible from Mounds.
[*]The portal to Blackfury Gorge and back is now accessible from Badlands.
[/list]

[b](continued in part 4)[/b]

[*]New System: Increases chance to recycle (not use) supplies.

[/list]

[b]If Vim is gone, does that mean I can craft endlessly?[/b] Yes. As long as you have the mats, you can craft for as long as you want. There is no gate.

[b]Will crafting use supplies?[/b] No. Supplies are used only in the gathering skills.

[b]What happens to golden tools in this new system?[/b] No change whatsoever. Golden tools yield the exact same results as before.


[h1][b]Art Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Made the female and male player hands smaller
[*]Improved many of the female faces and heads
[*]Improved the World Map
[*]Improved some of the local maps
[*]Made the trees look nicer (for the art techies, added custom normals to make them appear fuller). Also gave them a better texture.
[/list]
[h1][b]GUI Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]"Shop Vault" was renamed to "Shop Items".
[*]Added a total stack value to the tool-tips that tells you the selling price for the entire stack of items
[*]Quick action bars on the inventory window can now have bound hotkeys.
[/list]
[h1][b]Misc Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved Gardening rarities: Improved the rarity system of crops to help differentiate between different types (magical vs common, or hasty vs. normal)
[*]Added a Reflection slider to Settings->Graphics. Note: even on the second notch, reflections have a big impact on frame rate. Only on Extreme are they enabled by default, and even then not at the highest setting. However, if you have a fantastic graphics card, you could try moving reflections to the max.
[*]Improved the Stinging Blasio and Jabs daily quests
[*]The Villagers & Heroes 'Game Guide' on the web site has been updated, and now reflects all changes made within the past year, as well as new info for pre-existing sections.
[/list]
[h1][b]Graphics Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Boosted the frame rate by over 50%!
[*]Reflections now are ON when a player selects Extreme for graphics setting.
[*]Reflections no longer reflect everything in the scene - just the big stuff. (Reflections in the water now reflect the sky, the mountains, the clouds, but not all the creatures and trees. * This improves the frame rate.)
[*]Changed minimum res to 960x760
[*]The camera avoids fewer objects, leading to fewer jarring camera movements.
[/list]
[h1][b]Playbalance Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Reduced the amount of lucky gems that drop by but increased their sell value. Players will see a lot less gems popping out of gathering nodes and mob deaths, but because of the increased sale price the gold received by the player will be a perfect wash.
[*]We increased health regeneration when not in combat by 2.3x.
[*]We reduced crafting XP Requirements by a significant amount at the higher levels (so it will be a little easier to keep crafting levels equal to combat level).
[*]Because of this, several of the higher level recipes (levels 40+) will also change as well, lowering the base amount of refined materials needed.
[/list]
[h1][b]Pyrron Playbalance and Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Medallion Balancing: Addressing issues that we have heard from the community, we took a pass at the Pyrrus Medallion system, attempting to make it a bit easier and less of a grind.
[*]Added: Sapphirra's Lament, Pyrron Courtyard, Lower Keep, and Pyrron Mezzanine, now all drop Obsidian Medallions.
[*]Lowered: Bastion and Ramparts key prices have been lowered from 300 to 200 Obsidian Medallions
[*]Changed: Bastion and Ramparts no longer drop Obsidian Medallions, but instead drop Malachite Medallions.
[*]Lowered: Undercroft and Apothecary prices have been lowered from 700 to 325 Obsidian Medallions
[*]Lowered: Underbelly and Creation Caves have been lowered from 325 to 200 Malachite Medallions
[*]Changed: Underbelly and Creation Caves no longer drop Malachite Medallions, but instead drop Carnelian Medallions
[*]Added: Creation Caves, being a difficult zone to navigate, now has double medallion drops (all bounties drop 2 medallions).
[*]Lowered: Armory and Staging chambers have been lowered from 725 to 325 Malachite Medallions
[*]Lowered: Key to Keppel Cavern has been lowered from 750 to 600 Carnellian Medallions

[*]Pyrrick Acorns
[*]Pyrrick Acorns can now by purchased using any of the Pyrron Medallions types. Visit the Goblin vendors in Sapphiras Lament to see specific pricings.
[*]Drop rates on acorns has been increased slightly

[*]Stone Steps
[*]All Insurgent gear (rings, belts, and gloves that removes the stone step effects) have had their minimum level restriction reduced by two levels each.
[*]All Insurgent gear has had its gold value reduced by half.
[*]Stone Steps no longer nullifies all speed boost modifiers, but instead reduces any bonuses you do have, never reducing the player below default movement speed.
[*]Note: There will be no compensation for players who have already played through these zones with old stone steps effect.

[*]Zone Brightening: We have heard players mention that several of the cavernous Pyrrus zone feel too dark and gloomy. We want to take an attempt at making these zones more fun to be in (this does not affect the dungeon type environments).
[/list]
[h1][b]Low Level Zones - General Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved the Following Zones by adjusting the levels of the monsters and the quests and art improvements: Ardent City, Elk Meadow, Ardent Castle, Southern Coast, Kingsport, Shadow's Den (new zone!), Oak Valley, Villages, Mounds, Vinton, Bearhold Valley, Addict's Ascent, Cook Village, Traders Path, Green Gate, Sirens Course, Bearhold Crypt, Forgotten Reservoir, Southern Marsh, Zombie Town
[*]Old Summer's Hollow and Oak Valley have been visually updated and re-purposed to fit as level 15 and level 20 zones. Players might see a few familiar faces.
[*]Elk Shadow has moved from Elk Meadow. He found a new home...
[/list]
[h1][b]Portal Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]The portal to Maiden and back is now accessible from Mounds.
[*]The portal to Blackfury Gorge and back is now accessible from Badlands.
[/list]

[b](continued in part 4)[/b]

notes.title: REBORN Patch Notes - Part 2
notes.notes:
[b](continued from part 1)[/b]

There are three different categories of supplies, and each yields a greater benefit to the player who has equipped their tools with them. However, it is not a requirement that one must equip their tools in order to gather.

[list]

[h1][b]Using No Supplies[/b][/h1]

[*]Results in a 5 second gathering time
[*]50% chance to find gathering material (e.g. fish, ore, wood, etc.)
[*]100% chance to find 1-2 common gathering supplies for the current skill
[*]0% chance to find supplies for another skill

[h1][b]Using Common Supplies[/b][/h1]

[*]Results in a 3 second gathering time
[*]100% chance to find gathering material (fish, ore, wood, etc.)
[*]50% chance to find supplies for another skill (nectar, grindstones, etc.)

[h1][b]Using Superior Supplies[/b][/h1]

[*]Results in a 2 second gathering time
[*]100% chance to find gathering material (fish, ore, wood, etc)
[*]75% chance to find gathering supplies for another skill (grindstones, nectar, etc.)

[h1][b]Using Premium Supplies[/b][/h1]

[*]Results in a 1 second gathering time
[*]100% chance to find gathering material (fish, ore, wood, etc.)
[*]100% chance to find supplies for another skill (grindstone, worms, etc.)
[/list]

Superior and Premium Supplies are fully trade-able. Common supplies, unlike the others, are not trade-able. However, every 22 hours, all players will have a stock amount of Common Supplies replenished for free, if they visit certain NPC's. These NPC's, Distributors, belong to a special group known as the Coterie of Gatherers (C.O.G. for short) and they can be found in Ardent City, Summer’s Hollow, and on the shores of Lake Kiwa, with the other members of their Coterie. C.O.G members are easily recognizable in their green robes and blazing gold emblems.

[h1][b]Who are the members of the C.O.G, and what do they do?[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Distributors: C.O.G Distributors will serve out daily rations of supplies to all players. There is a C.O.G Distributor for Fishing, Mining, Plant Lore, and Bug Lore. Visit each of them once per day to collect your share.
[*]Patrons: C.O.G Patrons will take Common Supplies from you in trade for C.O.G. coins. C.O.G. coins can be redeemed at a C.O.G. Quartermaster.
[*]Quartermasters: C.O.G Quartermasters will sell you Common Supplies in exchange for varying rates of C.O.G coins.
[*]Vendors: C.O.G. Vendors will sell Common Supplies for varying rates of gold, the official currency of the Seven Realms.
[/list]

* C.O.G npc's only deal in Common Supplies, not Superior or Premium.

[h1][b]Motes of Yorick[/b][/h1]
When gathering, players will have a chance to find a Mote of Yorrick. These small energy orbs can be used to rapidly craft (in lieu of a mass producer.) These special Motes can also be purchased for gold, but they will not be sold in the item shop. Mass Producers will continue to be sold in the item shop, as will Clockwork Harvesters.

[h1][b]Where are all of these gathering supplies kept?[/b][/h1]
A tool bar will appear whenever players are engaged in a gathering skill. There are 3 slots in the bar, each slot relegated for common, superior, and premium supplies. Each slot holds 2500 supplies. Each of the four gathering skills have three such slots. (All of these slots are free.) The Character Window, in the ‘Skills’ section, also displays a player’s supplies.

Additionally, we have increased the inventory amount in bags, vaults, and lockers to 1000.

[h1][b]What happens to all your Vim and Vim-related items?[/b][/h1]
Vim has been removed entirely from the game. When you log in, all vim-related items will no longer be in your possession, but will have been converted into a special in-game currency called Crystallized Vim Shards. You will now have a choice of what you want to spend the Shards on. If you want to buy back the same items, which have been altered to fit the new system, you can. Or, if you decide you'd rather spend your Shards on other items within the new gathering system, you can do that as well. The choice is entirely yours.

In Ardent City, up near the castle, are a group of special NPC's dressed in purple. They will exchange items with you.

Here is a list of vim-related items, and how they now fit into the new system:

[list]

[h1][b]Cornucopia:[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: Gave a small amount of Vim.
[*]New System: Eating a cornucopia gives you a charged buff (similar to how a deluxe clockwork harvester works.) With the buff, the next time you gather you have a 90% increased chance to find a Mote of Yorick. The effect expires after a total of 3 gathers (charges). The charges scale up with the cooking/charter recipes.
[*]Note: The Overflowing Cornucopia recipe now requires 30 Cornucopias instead of 20, but it's Charter cost was reduced from 850 to 600 tokens.

[h1][b]Bounty Bosses:[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: Killing a bounty boss in your level range restored 2 Vim.
[*]New System: All bounty bosses (regardless of level difference) reward a crate that contains various types of supplies. The level of supplies depends on the level of the bounty boss.
[*]Old System: Killing a bounty gave you 1 stack on a buff that stacked to 75, each stack increased your maximum Vim by 2.
[*]New System: Bounty power works the same (1 stack per kill, stacks to 75). The buff now grants bonus chance to find supplies while gathering, and when you do find supplies, it increases the amount you find.

[h1][b]Bugs:[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: Increased max Vim.
[*]New System: While gathering, the chance to recycle (not use your selected supply) is increased.


[h1][b]Herbs:[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: eating herbs restored Vim.
[*]New System:
22 hour Herbs - Grants the Abundant Earth effect: While gathering, your chance to find supplies is increased. Additionally your chance to find a Mote of Yorick is increased. Lasts for 5 minutes.
2 hour Herbs - Grants the Bountiful Earth effect: While gathering, your chance to find supplies is increased. Additionally your chance to find a Mote of Yorick is increased. Lasts for 5 minutes.
Abundant Earth and Bountiful Earth may be active simultaneously.

[h1][b]Magical Seeds:[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: could be grown and consumed to increase max vim and replenish vim.
[*]New System:
Magic Vegetables now grant a large boost to gardening experience (the harvest can then be sold to a vendor or destroyed).
Magic Spices now grant a boost to sale price (gold).
Note: Magical seeds no longer tie into the gathering or crafting system.

[h1][b]Cooking Potions:[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: Increased Vim regeneration.
[*]Renamed: Potions of the Triad (the Legendary Three)
[*]New System: Your luck and prosperity while gathering, crafting, and working in your village is boosted. This includes recipe cost reduction while crafting, abundant harvests while gardening, and both lucky find and bonus supplies while gathering.

[h1][b]Yorick's Jewelry:[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: Increased Max Vim
[*]New System: You have an increased chance at finding a Mote of Yorick while gathering. Additionally, your chance to find supplies is boosted.

[h1][b]Xinzen Carp:[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: Could be consumed to give a swim speed boost and make it so you would gain Vim rather than spending it.
[*]New System: Can now be filleted to find what the fish has been munching on. Contains a swim speed potion and various large amounts of COG coins (used to purchase gathering supplies).

[h1][b]Charter Rewards:[/b][/h1]

[*]Old System: Vim potions could be purchased for various amounts of Charter Tokens.
[*]New System: All charter vendors now sell superior gathering supplies.

[b]{continued in part 3)[/b]

notes.title: REBORN Patch Notes - Part 1
notes.notes:
Here are all the new features of Reborn summed up in detail:

[h1][b]New Features and Major Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]New Character Create
[*]New Graphical User Interface
[*]New ‘Personality’ animations for players’ characters
[*]5 new starter zones
[*]New storyline with involved quests
[*]Voiced dialogue
[*]New intro video with a fly-over camera
[*]New Music
[*]New starter outfits
[*]New Crafting tutorials
[*]Older zones and villages have been given artistic makeovers
[*]‘Rebirth’: a new feature for capped players, or those over level 30
[/list]

[h1][b]Character Create (main new features)[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Voiced Narration -- A character from the story audibly prompts the player through the creation process. A sub-titles feature has also been added.
[*]Origin Starter packs -- players are given a free supply pack of various perks, each one corresponding to the realm of origin selected.
[*]Biography profiles -- players can choose their origin and background, as well as personalities which provide flavorful summaries of the characters they are creating.
[*]Personality animations -- players can choose between seven new animations and ambients: Heroic, Glamorous, Thoughtful, Pious, Brutish, Fearful, and Normal.
[*]Faces Improved -- new textures have been added, as well as a new head.
[*]Height Option -- players can choose the height of their character.
[*]Realm images -- Background scenes of each realm of origin are now depicted.
[*]Villager Options -- Choices for the crafting aspect of the game have been added, and are presented as being equally important as those of the adventuring aspect. Furthermore, XP levels for chosen skills have been increased to level 5 for all new players.
[*]House Selection -- players can now select their house styles in character create, and are provided with the information about the various housing perks.
[/list]

[h1][b]New User Interface (main new features)[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Quest Journal -- quests can be sorted by level or name, have been color-coded, can be filtered by the type of quest, and an option to view only certain quests at a time has been added.
[*]Character Window -- Broken down into four sub-categories, the character window replaces the previous ‘outfit’ window, and now separately displays: Stats, Talents, Skills, and player Bio.
[*]On-Screen Character Portrait -- An image of the player’s character is displayed at all times in the upper left hand corner of the screen. (Clicking on it will also open the ‘talents’ window.) Additionally, upon joining a party, pictures of all party members will also be displayed on screen.
[*]Inventory -- items in bags are now color coded according to the category they belong to.
[*]Shortcuts -- Shortcut icon tabs have been added on screen for the quest journal, friends lists, achievements, and the character window. These have all been removed from the ‘Menu’ tab.
[*]Quest tracking bar -- the icons for the five quests being tracked are now in upper corner of screen, aligned horizontally instead of vertically.
[*]Character select screen -- new background images based upon a player’s origin selection for their character now appear on the select page.
[/list]

[h1][b]New zones, New quests, and New Tutorials[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]5 brand new zones -- Ethos Island, Lower Ethos Island, Cronk Island, The Briny Caverns, and the Underground Sanctum. (The now much-changed town of Summer’s Hollow has moved, and can be found on Ethos Island.)
[*] Fly-cam video -- an introductory video takes the player on a brief tour of Ethos Island before setting them down in front of Summer’s Hollow.
[*]New Quests -- A series of lengthy, story-driven quests will keep players busy in all the new zones.
[*]Voiced Dialogue -- Over 60 different NPC’s in the new zones have speaking parts.
[*]New ‘Story Icon’ -- A purple exclamation mark over an NPC now indicates that the quest is part of the main storyline. (Yellow exclamation marks indicate side quests.)
[*]An Improved Crafting/Gathering Tutorial -- Extensive tutorials for all 8 skills have been added in the new zones.
[/list]

[h1][b]Old Zone Makeovers[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Artistic Touch-ups to old zones -- Ardent City, Ardent Castle, Lady’s Lake, Elk’s Meadow, Memorial Pond, Vinton, Mounds, Moonglade, Oak Valley, Kingsport, Southern Coast, Shadow's Den and Villages have all been enhanced.
[/list]

[h1][b]'Rebirth' - A feature which enables players at level 30 or above to begin anew with special advantages[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Players can return to level 1, and will be given 5 bonus talent points.
[*]Players will keep all of their prior crafting skills, elder levels, items, bags, gnogmentation packs, achievements, travel pad locations, and portal keys they earned before rebirthing.
[*]Players will lose all prior combat levels. All quest status,’ progress, and completions will be reset, as well as bounties and kill counts. All talents will be reset, and any talent points gained by leveling will also be lost. However, players will keep any talent points received for performing the rebirth.
[*]In addition to the five bonus talent points given, players will also receive a special hero experience bonus that stacks with all normal experience boosts. This bonus scales with level, becoming increasingly powerful upwards of a 400% boost.
[*]Players who undergo the rebirthing process will also receive a special emblem displayed in their player cameo text, which will indicate how many times they have been reborn.
[/list]
[b]Please note:[/b] at this time, such items as Yorick's Gathering Hat, Cheetah Boots, and Golden Winged Helm will lose their proficiencies after a player performs a Rebirth. However, we will be implementing tech in several weeks time, which will ensure that the proficiencies on the items will remain.

[h1][b]A new gathering system[/b][/h1]

How does it work?

Gathering from any resource requires a specific tool. Fishing requires a pole. Mining requires a pick-axe, Wood, fruit, and mushroom picking require a scythe. Bug collecting requires a magnifying glass. Each tool can be equipped with unique supplies which provide special advantages to the gatherer. These supplies are found in the different gathering nodes within the world, and are interdependent upon each other, thereby forming a circle of life.

[list]
[*]Mining supplies can be gained while fishing and mining.
[*]Plant Lore supplies can be gained while mining and doing plant gathering.
[*]Bug Lore supplies can be gained while doing Plant Lore, and collecting bugs.
[*]Fishing supplies can be gained while doing Bug Lore and fishing.
[/list]
Examples of supplies:
[list]
[*]Grindstones aid in plant lore, and can be used to sharpen scythes.
[*]Fishing Worms aid in fishing, and act as tantalizing bait.
[*]Natural oils aid in mining, and can improve the metal of the pick-axe.
[*]Nectar aids in the collection of bugs.
[/list]

[b](continued in part 2)[/b]

[*]Older zones and villages have been given artistic makeovers
[*]‘Rebirth’: a new feature for capped players, or those over level 30
[/list]

[h1][b]Character Create (main new features)[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Voiced Narration -- A character from the story audibly prompts the player through the creation process. A sub-titles feature has also been added.
[*]Origin Starter packs -- players are given a free supply pack of various perks, each one corresponding to the realm of origin selected.
[*]Biography profiles -- players can choose their origin and background, as well as personalities which provide flavorful summaries of the characters they are creating.
[*]Personality animations -- players can choose between seven new animations and ambients: Heroic, Glamorous, Thoughtful, Pious, Brutish, Fearful, and Normal.
[*]Faces Improved -- new textures have been added, as well as a new head.
[*]Height Option -- players can choose the height of their character.
[*]Realm images -- Background scenes of each realm of origin are now depicted.
[*]Villager Options -- Choices for the crafting aspect of the game have been added, and are presented as being equally important as those of the adventuring aspect. Furthermore, XP levels for chosen skills have been increased to level 5 for all new players.
[*]House Selection -- players can now select their house styles in character create, and are provided with the information about the various housing perks.
[/list]

[h1][b]New User Interface (main new features)[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Quest Journal -- quests can be sorted by level or name, have been color-coded, can be filtered by the type of quest, and an option to view only certain quests at a time has been added.
[*]Character Window -- Broken down into four sub-categories, the character window replaces the previous ‘outfit’ window, and now separately displays: Stats, Talents, Skills, and player Bio.
[*]On-Screen Character Portrait -- An image of the player’s character is displayed at all times in the upper left hand corner of the screen. (Clicking on it will also open the ‘talents’ window.) Additionally, upon joining a party, pictures of all party members will also be displayed on screen.
[*]Inventory -- items in bags are now color coded according to the category they belong to.
[*]Shortcuts -- Shortcut icon tabs have been added on screen for the quest journal, friends lists, achievements, and the character window. These have all been removed from the ‘Menu’ tab.
[*]Quest tracking bar -- the icons for the five quests being tracked are now in upper corner of screen, aligned horizontally instead of vertically.
[*]Character select screen -- new background images based upon a player’s origin selection for their character now appear on the select page.
[/list]

[h1][b]New zones, New quests, and New Tutorials[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]5 brand new zones -- Ethos Island, Lower Ethos Island, Cronk Island, The Briny Caverns, and the Underground Sanctum. (The now much-changed town of Summer’s Hollow has moved, and can be found on Ethos Island.)
[*] Fly-cam video -- an introductory video takes the player on a brief tour of Ethos Island before setting them down in front of Summer’s Hollow.
[*]New Quests -- A series of lengthy, story-driven quests will keep players busy in all the new zones.
[*]Voiced Dialogue -- Over 60 different NPC’s in the new zones have speaking parts.
[*]New ‘Story Icon’ -- A purple exclamation mark over an NPC now indicates that the quest is part of the main storyline. (Yellow exclamation marks indicate side quests.)
[*]An Improved Crafting/Gathering Tutorial -- Extensive tutorials for all 8 skills have been added in the new zones.
[/list]

[h1][b]Old Zone Makeovers[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Artistic Touch-ups to old zones -- Ardent City, Ardent Castle, Lady’s Lake, Elk’s Meadow, Memorial Pond, Vinton, Mounds, Moonglade, Oak Valley, Kingsport, Southern Coast, Shadow's Den and Villages have all been enhanced.
[/list]

[h1][b]'Rebirth' - A feature which enables players at level 30 or above to begin anew with special advantages[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Players can return to level 1, and will be given 5 bonus talent points.
[*]Players will keep all of their prior crafting skills, elder levels, items, bags, gnogmentation packs, achievements, travel pad locations, and portal keys they earned before rebirthing.
[*]Players will lose all prior combat levels. All quest status,’ progress, and completions will be reset, as well as bounties and kill counts. All talents will be reset, and any talent points gained by leveling will also be lost. However, players will keep any talent points received for performing the rebirth.
[*]In addition to the five bonus talent points given, players will also receive a special hero experience bonus that stacks with all normal experience boosts. This bonus scales with level, becoming increasingly powerful upwards of a 400% boost.
[*]Players who undergo the rebirthing process will also receive a special emblem displayed in their player cameo text, which will indicate how many times they have been reborn.
[/list]
[b]Please note:[/b] at this time, such items as Yorick's Gathering Hat, Cheetah Boots, and Golden Winged Helm will lose their proficiencies after a player performs a Rebirth. However, we will be implementing tech in several weeks time, which will ensure that the proficiencies on the items will remain.

[h1][b]A new gathering system[/b][/h1]

How does it work?

Gathering from any resource requires a specific tool. Fishing requires a pole. Mining requires a pick-axe, Wood, fruit, and mushroom picking require a scythe. Bug collecting requires a magnifying glass. Each tool can be equipped with unique supplies which provide special advantages to the gatherer. These supplies are found in the different gathering nodes within the world, and are interdependent upon each other, thereby forming a circle of life.

[list]
[*]Mining supplies can be gained while fishing and mining.
[*]Plant Lore supplies can be gained while mining and doing plant gathering.
[*]Bug Lore supplies can be gained while doing Plant Lore, and collecting bugs.
[*]Fishing supplies can be gained while doing Bug Lore and fishing.
[/list]
Examples of supplies:
[list]
[*]Grindstones aid in plant lore, and can be used to sharpen scythes.
[*]Fishing Worms aid in fishing, and act as tantalizing bait.
[*]Natural oils aid in mining, and can improve the metal of the pick-axe.
[*]Nectar aids in the collection of bugs.
[/list]

[b](continued in part 2)[/b]

notes.title: Villagers & Heroes: REBORN will launch on Monday, June 8th!
notes.notes:
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/reborn_splash_launchdate_steam.jpg[/img]

Mad Otter Games is very excited to announce the release date of [b]Villagers and Heroes: REBORN[/b], the latest in a long line of changes that brings a whole new life to the game. Not only can veteran players find exciting new content and features with this major expansion, but we have re-designed the entire game and especially the starter zone to make those first several hours in the game more exciting and immersive.

REBORN will launch on Monday, June 8th, at 11 am Eastern / 8 am Pacific.

REBORN includes these major new improvements:

[list]
[*][b]A Mystery to Solve[/b] - Who is the Malicious Miscreant, and why are citizens of Summer's Hollow mysteriously disappearing?
[*][b]The Circle of Life[/b] - An all new gathering supply system that completely replaces the unpopular ENERGY / Vim system formerly featured in the game.  Worms for fishing, Nectar for bug collecting, Grind Stones for your plant sickle, etc.
[*][b]Voice Acting and Musical Score[/b] - Professional voice actors for the major quests in the game
[*][b]Complete Face Lift[/b] - Literally and otherwise- most of the world has been completely redone with new artwork (models and painted texture), completely new User Interface, and new character facial choices have been added.
[*][b]Wider Breadth of Choices for your Character[/b] - Apart from choosing your appearance and class specialization, you can now choose your personality type (complete with appropriate body pose), your origin, and your skills as a villager.
[*][b]Be Reborn![/b] Enter the Temple of Rebirth to unlearn all your combat skills and start anew, but this time with the advantage of more skills to unlock, and without losing all of your character’s knowledge of gathering, crafting, gear and items, and greatly accelerated learning!
[/list]

More information on REBORN can be found at www.vhreborn.com or the Steam Community page of the game.

notes.title: REBORN: The Rebirth ritual
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.villagersandheroes.com/reborn][img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/5_header.png[/img] [/url]

Relive your past! In Villagers & Heroes: Reborn, your character can undergo several Rebirths - where they return to level one and get to re-experience the game, but keeping all valuables and non-combat skill levels. Characters who have undergone a Rebirth will also receive extra talent points and a boost to gained combat XP. 

[h1][b]Perform the ritual...[/b][/h1]
To perform a Rebirth you must make it to the Temple of Rebirth, where the mysterious ways of reliving your life are revealed. If you pass the tests of the ritual, you are Reborn.

This ritual can be performed four times - at level 30, 45, 60 and 75. Each time further stat points are granted, culminating in a bonus of 20 points if you have been reborn all four times.

[h1][b]...and everyone will see[/b][/h1]
Characters who have undergone a Rebirth will have special ornaments attached to their portraits - so others can always tell that you have undergone the Ritual.

Your ornaments grow more beautiful and intricate with each Rebirth, so you can finally wear the insigina of ultimate wisdom. 

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/otin.png[/img]

[h1][b]Everything is reborn.[/b][/h1]
There is much, much more to see in Villagers & Heroes: Reborn - but that is for you to discover! Stay tuned as we get closer to the release of this brand new chapter of Villagers & Heroes history. See you in the Seven Realms!

notes.title: REBORN: Graphics, zones and UI overhaul
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.villagersandheroes.com/reborn][img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/4_header.png[/img] [/url]

Old Ardent remade! In Reborn, existing areas of the game have been remade to look more interesting, more believable and more atmospheric. Take a look below at just a few examples of how Reborn brings new life to old regions of Ardent!

(old versions on the left)

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/comparison1.png[/img]

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/comparison2.png[/img]

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/comparison3.png[/img]

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/comparison4.png[/img]

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/comparison5.png[/img]


[h1][b]New User Interface[/b][/h1]
The UI of Reborn has been redesigned from the ground up, retailored to provide a faster and more immersive experience. Below can be seen just a few examples of redesigned areas of the UI, and how they make the game easier and more fun to play. 


[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/character.png[/img]
[h1][b]Stats, skills, talents & bio[/b][/h1]
Find all the information on your character in one place with the new Character window! Check on your stats, your talents, your equipment and your skills - even your personal biography - all in a single spot.
And there's more! Apart from bringing everything together, there are also far more stats shown, color coding of equipped items, undoable talents, better tracking of skill levels, and much more. 


[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/inventory.png[/img]
[h1][b]Inventory[/b][/h1]
Manage your items and equipment easier than ever before! Reborn's redesigned inventory now color codes all your items. Can't find that enormously rare sword you found yesterday? It's easily located! Looking for all your less valuable items? Easy to sort out!
The inventory is also larger in size, increasing the space between item slots and making it less easier to select just the item you want. 


[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/logbook.png[/img]
[h1][b]Quests and bounties[/b][/h1]
Reborn features a completely new Logbook to track your quests - no longer will you have to scroll through an endlessly long list to find the quest you need! Quest can now be sorted and filtered however you wish. View only main quests, hide completed quests, sort quests alphabetically - and much more. There is also much more space to read quest descriptions, making it much easier to browse through large, complex quests. 


[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/crafting.png[/img]
[h1][b]Crafting[/b][/h1]
Crafting is made much easier with a new, redesigned crafting window. Sort based on only specific classes, filter by min and max level, and see more information about what you want to craft. The new crafting window also makes it much easier to choose exactly the amount of items you want to craft with a new, far more precise slider. 


[h1][b]And much more![/b][/h1]
This is only a small preview of the new UI - much more is included in Reborn. See a more informative and polished HUD, a beautiful new way to choose between your characters, new loading screens for all hundreds of zones in the game, and much, much more.

notes.title: REBORN: No more energy - and a new way to gather and craft
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.villagersandheroes.com/reborn][img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/3_header.png[/img] [/url]

Be one with the land! Reborn brings the [b]removal of the old energy mechanic[/b] known as Vim - and in its place is a gathering system centered around natural ways to gather and craft.

[h1]Players who own existing Vim-related items will be able to trade them in for powerful in-game rewards - rest assured no matter how much time or money you have invested into the Vim mechanic, it will not be lost.[/h1]

At the heart of the new system are supplies - natural supplies which, when used together with a gathering tool, will make you gather faster and find better materials. There are four kinds of supplies, one for each gathering skill:

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/supplies.png[/img]

[h1][b]Find supplies by gathering[/b][/h1]
Supplies are found as you gather - gathering one kind of resource gives you the supplies you need to gather another. Fishing Worms, for instance, can be found by searching for bugs, which in turn uses Nectar that can be found while harvesting plants. In addition to this, sometimes you find supplies for the kind of gathering you are currently doing - so you may also find Fishing Worms by fishing, Nectar while collecting bugs, and so on. See how it works for each skill below! 

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/circleoflife.png[/img]

[h1][b]Some supplies are better than others[/b][/h1]
All supplies come in three different rarities. Since you can also gather with no supplies if you choose to, this means that there are four different ways of gathering:

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/rarities.png[/img]

[h1][b]Trade and exchange supplies[/b][/h1]
Superior and Premium supplies are always tradeable with other players. Common supplies are not, but they can still be traded with certain NPCs - the Coterie of Gatherers, or C.O.G. for short. There are several kinds of C.O.G. members - take a look at all of them below! 

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/cog.png[/img]

[h1][b]Stay Tuned...[/b][/h1]
Over the next few weeks, many more new features for Villagers and Heroes: Reborn will be announced.  This is only the beginning of the journey.

notes.title: REBORN: New lands to explore
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.villagersandheroes.com/reborn][img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/2_header.png[/img] [/url]

Welcome to Ethos Island! Uncover the secrets of this exotic land in an immersive new storyline where challenging quests will take players into five new regions, each area filled with countless locations to explore, dangerous foes to battle, and a dark mystery in need of solving.

Take a closer look at all the new content at the [url=http://www.villagersandheroes.com/reborn/]Villagers and Heroes: Reborn expansion website.[/url]

[h1][b]Uncover the mystery[/b][/h1]
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/story.png[/img]

A mysterious villain. An insidious spell. Time is running out for the citizens of Summer’s Hollow! A hero is needed, someone with the bravery and the smarts to unravel a beguiling whodunit.

Be that hero, and embark upon a series of challenging quests, rich with lore and rife with danger. Unmask and defeat the evil being who is terrorizing the land, and save the townspeople before it is too late.


[h1][b]Ethos Island[/b][/h1]

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/zones_ethosisland.gif[/img]

Summer’s Hollow, a bustling town of trade and merriment, is the beating heart of the island, though many adore the tranquil scenery of nearby Gandymeade Grove. But it is to the town that people flock, especially now, when the lavish yearly festival is in full swing. Many hope to catch a glimpse of the most famous actress in all of the Seven Realms, Ms. Clementine DeClancy. 

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/zones_small_ethosisland.gif[/img]


[h1][b]Lower Ethos Island[/b][/h1]

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/zones_lowerethosisland.gif[/img]

Golden meadows, a lush fen, and expansive farmlands abound. But the dedicated homesteaders of this peaceful region are now in a state of hysteria, fearful that the villain known only as ‘The Malicious Miscreant’ will destroy all they have worked for, and inflict the darkness of the Shadow Years upon the world again. 

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/zones_small_lowerethosisland.gif[/img]


[h1][b]Cronk Island[/b][/h1]

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/zones_cronkisland.gif[/img]

A foul chunk of diseased rock, inhabited only by ghastly beasts and deranged outcasts. But this place of whispers and screams harbors a vital secret, one well shrouded with time. It will take a truly courageous hero to unlock the mysteries of so abhorrent an island. 

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/zones_small_cronkisland.gif[/img]


[h1][b]Briny Caverns[/b][/h1]

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/zones_brinycaverns.gif[/img]

This maze of watery tunnels and mossy caves where emerald waterfalls and eerie wonders abound, is home to both creatures of light and of the dark. It is a ghostly boat which will aid those in need of answers, but to where it sails, few have returned from. 

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/zones_small_brinycaverns.gif[/img]


[h1][b]Stay Tuned...[/b][/h1]
Over the next few weeks, many more new features for Villagers and Heroes: Reborn will be announced.  This is only the beginning of the journey.

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/1_image_4.png[/img]

Over the next few weeks, many more new features for Villagers and Heroes: Reborn will be announced.  This is only the beginning of the journey.

notes.title: English Patchnotes 2.40.4 - Thursday February 19 2015
notes.notes:
[h1]  Full Release Notes [/h1]
 [b]   May you all have visions of sugar-plums dancing in your heads! [/b]

    This patch has a new holiday event zone, "Sugarsweet Summit", a new outfit, bug fixes, and a few improvements.

 [u]   Improvements [/u]
[list]
    [*]    Sugarsweet Summit, a new event zone, is up now.
    [*]    Improved Advanced Lighting so it takes up less memory, which should hopefully make it faster and less prone to crashes. (With Advanced Lighting on, in Ardent this saves about 200 Megs!)
    [*]    Removed the "Friend All" pop up that occurs when moving into a village (due to popular request).
    [*]    Spirit Regeneration when out of combat is a little slower than before.
    [*]    Changed Fishing and Bug Collecting so they take nearly the same amount of time to do as Mining and Plants. (hopefully) reduced the time to pet and feed ranching animals (untested).
     [*]   The effects section on tooltips for loot and gatherables will now be smaller, but will expand after hover for a second or two. This should make tooltips for gatherables less annoying when gathering many items.
     [*]   Monsters and players using click-to-move are better now at avoiding obstacles.
     [*]   We made the coin loot stacks a little more visible.
      [*]  Boosted the drop rate of the Pyrrick Acorn.
[/list]



 [u]   Bug Fixes [/u]
[list]
    [*]    Hopefully fixed a gnogmentation bug causing certain items to be shown as empty, even though they have talents attached.
     [*]   Fixed underwater fog in advanced lighting mode.
     [*]   Cleaned up some boss exclamations
     [*]   Made friendlies so they cannot enter Aegis.
      [*]  Hopefully fixed bug causing players to get stuck in a weird "dead" state requiring a relog to fix.
     [*]   Hopefully fixed the cause of many cases of getting permanently stuck at 0% loading in a zone.
     [*]   Hopefully fixed a very rare bug that could prevent mail from being viewed.
     [*]   Fixed: Players can't remove other players from friends list nor guild if their name contains an umlaut ( ä, ü, and ö )
    [*]    Fixed a bug where a player could close the game while teleporting, and effectively cancel the teleport.
    [*]    Fixed: /cinfo and /kick aren't working with names with ä,ü,ö,ß
[/list]

notes.title: To our Brazilian Players - Novo Servidor do Villagers and Heroes no Brasil
notes.notes:
Olá comunidade,

Viemos anunciar uma série de mudanças e melhorias para o Villagers and Heroes Brasil. Somos a empresa Looki responsável pela adminsitração e gestão de diversos jogos de web conhecidos internacionalmente, como Desert Operations, Empire Universe 3 e muitos outros e há uns meses fechamos parceria com a Mad Otter para gerenciarmos o Villagers and Heroes Brasil, tranzendo assim um novo servidor. Com essa mudança teremos que migrar todas as contas para o novo servidor melhorando a jogabilidade. A migração foi terminada com sucesso.

Com a migração do servidor brasileiro para os servidores da Looki, jogadores que acessam o jogo via STEAM devem proceder da seguinte forma para acessar ao novo servidor:

1. clicar com o botão direito do mouse no nome do jogo e acessar propriedades:

[img]http://www.villagersandheroes.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/vh_steam021.png[/img]

 2. Em idioma, escolha o idioma português:

[img]http://www.villagersandheroes.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/vh_steam01.png[/img]

A partir disto, seu cliente STEAM se sincronizará com o novo servidor e você poderá acessar ao servidor BR.

Quem tiver qualquer dúvida envie um ticket para o suporte através desse link: [url=http://www.looki.net.br/support/newticket.php?category=335]Suporte[/url]

A página do jogo continará sendo a mesma e estaremos postando lá, e também no fórum, todas as informações e mudanças que ocorrer no servidor brasileiro.

Link da página do jogo: [url=http://community.villagersandheroes.net/]Página do Jogo[/url]

Link do fórum: [url=http://www.looki.net.br/forum/forumdisplay.php?f=1045]Fórum[/url]

notes.title: Sugarsweet Summit
notes.notes:
A deliciously intoxicating special event zone is soon to be arriving in Ardent!  
[img]http://i.imgur.com/XqEECxN.jpg[/img]
Players, many clad in shiny new cupid wings, but armed with the sturdiest of weapons, will be exploring the pink hills and rolling glens of Sugarsweet Summit -- a place where frighteningly plump ne’er-do-wells lurk inside of candy-coated caverns and are ready to pounce on all who disturb their feeding frenzies.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Gki1HRb.jpg?1[/img]
Sugarsweet Summit offers players of all levels the chance to reap vast rewards and goodies.  For the combat inclined, 6 formidable Elder Bosses await.  Be warned though, these challenging foes are not for the faint of heart and will surely require a large party of heroes to take them down.  And for our craft-loving players, the Summit offers much to do in the way of multiple daily quests, not to mention the return of our beloved February friends, Valentino and Valentina.

What else does Sugarsweet Summit possess?  (Pssst!  Lolly-Grams anyone?)  Here’s just a few of the things this delightful zone will have to offer:
[list]
[*]An event-themed weapon pack with a brand new special cosmetic feat

[*]5 brand new outfits in the item shop, and 3 special outfits in the event zone only

[*]Cupid Wings

[*]New feature:  Lolly-Grams!  Create a lolly gram with a special custom note, and send it to your friend with a gift attached

[*]New feature: ‘Echo Bounty.’ Killing an elder boss on Sugarsweet Summit gives you great rewards once per day. In addition, players can kill the boss again for an echo bounty reward. Echo bounty rewards can be earned any number of times per day.

[*]Free goodies everywhere!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/IaFyG6b.jpg?1[/img]

Get ready to swoon and slay, gorge on goodies, and most of all, enjoy the company of your friends in this fun-filled event zone.  See you all soon in Sugarsweet Summit!

And for our craft-loving players, the Summit offers much to do in the way of multiple daily quests, not to mention the return of our beloved February friends, Valentino and Valentina.

What else does Sugarsweet Summit possess?  (Pssst!  Lolly-Grams anyone?)  Here’s just a few of the things this delightful zone will have to offer:
[list]
[*]An event-themed weapon pack with a brand new special cosmetic feat

[*]5 brand new outfits in the item shop, and 3 special outfits in the event zone only

[*]Cupid Wings

[*]New feature:  Lolly-Grams!  Create a lolly gram with a special custom note, and send it to your friend with a gift attached

[*]New feature: ‘Echo Bounty.’ Killing an elder boss on Sugarsweet Summit gives you great rewards once per day. In addition, players can kill the boss again for an echo bounty reward. Echo bounty rewards can be earned any number of times per day.

[*]Free goodies everywhere!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/IaFyG6b.jpg?1[/img]

Get ready to swoon and slay, gorge on goodies, and most of all, enjoy the company of your friends in this fun-filled event zone.  See you all soon in Sugarsweet Summit!

notes.title: Patch 2.34 - A lot has changed since April...
notes.notes:
[b]We have been listening! See what has been improved in [i]Villagers and Heroes![/i][/b]

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/JYHwlwP.png?1[/IMG]

[h1][b]What has changed since the game launched on Steam in April?[/b][/h1]

[b]In short:[/b][list]
[*]Much improved fluid, action-oriented combat
[*]Removal of the pay for energy mechanic
[*]A vast improvement on our social features and UI
[*]The addition of rolling, both as a fun movement option, but also as a dodging game mechanic
[*]Spell fusions, and a focus on teamwork and party mechanics
[*]Crash fixes, bug fixes, faster download
[*]More ambient sounds like footsteps
[*]More emotes like dancing
[*]And a whole slew of new content, including new end game content, revamped tutorials, and new events[/list]

[h1][b]And all of these changes were based on feedback from you the players! We have been listening![/b][/h1]

Since launching on Steam five months ago, we’ve taken the excellent suggestions and feedback provided by all of our users, and vastly improved our game as a result.  Our latest build, [i]Sands of the Equinox 2.34[/i], while featuring an intoxicating new event with an array of desert themed bosses, bounties, and loot, is also characterized by a number of other changes we’ve made with regards to basic game mechanics and style of play – changes that players of any level, high or low, will surely find exciting.

For the adventurously inclined, you’ll be thrilled to discover that we’ve revamped our entire combat system so that it’s not only more fluid and responsive, but it now includes a variety of dynamic new actions and movements -- aerial acrobatics, tucking and rolling, agile strafing, increased acceleration while attacking foes, and more. With the addition of tucking and rolling also comes the ability to dodge, time your defense, tuck and roll out of the way dodging the coming onslaught. We also spent a large portion of time fine tuning our classes, improving visual and audio effects, adding new spells and feats, and finally adding spell fusions, where party members can fuse their feats and spells with one another, creating more powerful and devastating effects. 

And for our craft loving players, because we firmly believe that [i]Villagers and Heroes[/i] should be accessible to all users alike, we have completely removed the ‘Pay-for-Energy’ mechanic from within our game.  Our new system, one which allows for ‘Vim’ to be naturally replenished by crafters in all manner of different ways, contains a plethora of ways to engage with, strategize about, and take advantage of.  Thus, players can advance in crafting more rapidly through savvy gameplay and strategy.

Patch 2.34 marks an exciting turn for us!  Thanks to the invaluable feedback from our community, modifications, great and small, have been made across the board:  players can now dance and sit, and listen to the sound of their own running footsteps as they explore secret new areas in the lower zones where an array of entertaining surprises now await.  High level players will not only revel in the addition of fourteen brand new zones with challenging quest chains to unravel, but we’ve also included an end game mechanic which will hereafter keep players consistently engaged even after reaching level cap.  Moreover, players of all levels will be happy to find that we’ve revamped our housing policies, fixed countless bugs, greatly sped up the download time of the game, added new feats and spells, not to mention an entire upgrade on all of our social features, and two special event zones concurrently running.  And that’s just the short list of changes we’ve made…

So thank you, new players and veteran players alike!  Our game is better because of you all.  But don’t take our word for it.  Experience [i]Sands of the Equinox 2.34[/i] for yourselves.   We’ve been listening, and you won’t be disappointed. 

[h1][b]If you want the details of what has changed, check out our patch notes:[/b][h1]
[list]
[*][b]2.34:[/b] https://forum.villagersandheroes.com/showthread.php?9763-English-Patchnotes-2-34-5-Tuesday-September-23
[*][b]2.33:[/b] https://forum.villagersandheroes.com/showthread.php?9666-English-Patchnotes-2-33-6-Tuesday-September-9
[*][b]2.32:[/b] https://forum.villagersandheroes.com/showthread.php?9542-English-Patchnotes-2-32-4-Wednesday-August-20-2014
[*][b]2.31:[/b] https://forum.villagersandheroes.com/showthread.php?9335-English-Patchnotes-2-31-0-Tuesday-July-22-2014
[*][b]2.30:[/b] https://forum.villagersandheroes.com/showthread.php?9287-Release-2-30-0-Echoes-of-the-Past
[*][b]2.28:[/b] https://forum.villagersandheroes.com/showthread.php?8967-English-Patch-Notes-2-28-4-Tuesday-June-3-2014
[*][b]2.27:[/b] https://forum.villagersandheroes.com/showthread.php?8711-English-Patch-Notes-2-27-3-Wednesday-May-7
[/list]

notes.title: Midsummer's Eve has Arrived!
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O1LASh9_-OM] (See the video here) [/url]

Midsummer’s Eve has arrived, a time of year when the Fae visit to spread mirth and mischief.

Check out the new Midsummer's Eve Faerie wing outfit, the Lantern outfit, and the Nymph outfit.

In addition, we have made improvements to combat that allow you to move and attack and cast spells at the same time.

The build has a new system in place for Energy, or rather, Vim. Of course, changing the name from Energy to Vim and its color from yellow to purple does not change its nature (“A rose by any other name…” etc.) We have also changed the nature of the system from being a cash shop mechanic to a PURELY in game mechanic. Energy (now Vim) can no longer be purchased, but has to be earned through in game strategy, planning, and game play.

Full patch notes can be viewed here (our forums): https://forum.villagersandheroes.com/showthread.php?8967-English-Patch-Notes-2-28-4-Tuesday-June-3-2014
